title: Part Time Remote Licensed Talk Therapist - Fee For Service
description:
Thriveworks is currently seeking Licensed Clinicians to provide telehealth sessions in California. 


About the job
Thriveworks is a mental health care company founded by clinicians in 2008 and still led by them today. With 340+ locations and a nationwide hybrid care model, we serve over 175,000 clients annually through more than 1.7 million sessions, and we're growing. In addition to working directly with clients, we partner with health systems and primary care providers because we believe mental health is inseparable from physical health. As a clinician-led organization, we're built to support the people who do this work with the tools, community, and stability you need to build a career that lasts.


About the Role
We’re hiring licensed clinicians to provide compassionate, evidence-based care to our more than 175,000 clients across the country. You may be a good fit for this role if you’re:

  • Independently licensed and living in California — LPCC, LMFT, LCSW, PhD (Licensed Psychologist)

  • Consistently available to clients for a minimum of 15 sessions with 20 hours of availability weekly 

  • A behavioral health generalist who is open to treating a variety of clients, including couples and children

  • Invested in helping your clients achieve measurable progress

  • Confident working with modern clinical technology, including telehealth and EHR tools

  • A good teammate — we’re building a clinical community and value positive contributors

Compensation
Up to $62,000 based on licensure type, session volume, and bonus opportunities.

How We Support You
We handle the administrative work so you can focus on what you do best: providing exceptional care. That means credentialing, billing, scheduling, and marketing support taken care of for you, plus paid orientation and training to get you started. You'll build a full caseload within 90 days of credentialing, with flexible scheduling available seven days a week from 7 a.m. to 10 p.m. ET.


Benefits

  • As a W2 employee, you'll be eligible to receive:
  • Guaranteed bi-weekly pay for completed sessions
  • 401(k) with employer matching 
  • Paid time off
  • CEU reimbursement and free in-house training
  • Opportunities for paid clinical supervisor roles in select states


Our Community
Being a clinician can feel isolating, especially in a telehealth world. We're built to make sure it doesn't. You'll have access to live clinical support, monthly case consultations, and a vibrant online and in-person community of more than 2,700 licensed providers. All clinical leadership is promoted from within, so the people supporting you have been exactly where you are.


Ready to Join Us?

title: Technology Alliances Manager
description:
Role Overview

NetBox Labs is seeking a Technology Alliances Manager to own and scale our strategic technology ecosystem. This is a senior individual contributor role with direct business impact and high executive visibility. You will be the primary relationship owner and joint go-to-market driver for our most strategic technology partners — Red Hat Ansible, Nvidia, Cisco, HPE, Arista Networks, and Itential — with one clear mandate: open doors, drive business, and convert these relationships into revenue-producing routes to market for NetBox Labs, up to and including placement on our partners’ global price lists.

Four of our five priority partners are among the largest technology companies in the world, where executive access is earned, not given. We’re looking for a sophisticated, alliance professional with relentless energy, initiative, and creativity — someone who builds their own momentum, navigates complex global organizations to reach the executives who matter, and is equally comfortable and productive with a senior leader in São Paulo, Bangalore, or Munich: a true citizen of the world. Reporting to the Vice President of Global Partnerships, you will work closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing — and you will define the objectives and metrics by which NetBox Labs’ executive leadership tracks the alliance program’s progress.

What You’ll Do

Alliance Strategy & Executive Access

  • Own the global technology alliance strategy across Red Hat Ansible, Nvidia, Cisco, HPE, Arista Networks, and Itential, ensuring the portfolio aligns with NetBox Labs’ product vision, platform priorities, and go-to-market objectives.

  • Map the organization, build champions at every level, and convert them into VP- and C-suite sponsorship — these doors do not open by themselves.

  • Run two motions in parallel: land fast, visible wins with nimble partners like Itential while executing the longer, more complex campaigns required to break through at Cisco, HPE, Arista, and Red Hat.

  • Define partner tiering, engagement models, and investment levels across the technology alliance portfolio, and identify emerging partnership opportunities in adjacent ecosystems.

Routes to Market & Joint Go-to-Market Execution

  • Drive NetBox Labs onto partner global price lists and into resale, OEM, and marketplace programs that connect our products to partner sales organizations worldwide.

  • Design and launch joint GTM programs — co-sell motions, joint solution packaging, co-marketing campaigns, and field enablement — with success measured in programs launched and partner-influenced pipeline.

  • Build multi-year joint business plans and lead complex commercial engagements, including contract negotiations, pricing strategy, and incentive structures.

This role combines video editing, 2D motion graphics, animation, and visual storytelling to turn scripts and storyboards into clear, engaging, and polished videos. You’ll work with voiceovers, live-action footage, graphics, diagrams, and basic 3D elements while maintaining strong pacing, visual consistency, and technical quality. title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer / SRE – Kubernetes & Hybrid Cloud (m/f/d)
description:
Introduction

At a glance

  • Location &workmodel:Berlin, hybrid
  • Tech stack:Kubernetes on our own servers, Harvester (KubeVirt), Argo CD/Flux, Prometheus/Grafana, Longhorn/Ceph
  • Team:A growing SRE team – you report to our CTPO for now and to the Team Lead SREwe'rehiring next; two system administrators in Pforzheim run the physical hardware
  • Process:Intro call · take-home task (~2h) · 90-min tech interview with our developers · leadership conversation · meet the team

Why this role is special

Most SRE jobs today mean clicking around a managed cloud console. This one doesn't. We run our own hardware in Frankfurt and are building a modern private cloud platform on Kubernetes and Harvester – on-prem by default, with elastic burst into the public cloud and the option to go cloud-only later. You won't inherit a finished SRE practice: you'll help define it, side by side with our Berlin development teams – and you won't do it alone, a Team Lead SRE hire is coming next.

SRE here is an enabling discipline: you build what our developers need to ship reliably, while two system administrators in Pforzheim run the physical hardware. And the impact is direct – our product discovery technology powers more than 2,000 European online shops (Intersport, SPAR, Douglas and more), handling billions of shopper queries a year. When product discovery is slow or down, our customers lose revenue in real time.

You get to know both products, join the on-call rotation with a buddy, and own your first reliability topic – SLOs for one product, alerting that actually helps at 3 a.m., or automating away a piece of toil. By day 90 you've shipped visible improvements and know where you want to take the platform next.

title: Applied Operations Research Engineer
description:
We are building the world's decision infrastructure: the strategic twin of every industrial organization for complex combinatorial problems. We unlocked what wasn't possible before: mapping reality with its levers and constraints into a computer, then running n-dimensional optimization on critical value-chain decisions. We help Europe stay strong and the German Mittelstand make good decisions between market shifts, orders, machines and people.

Founded by Dana (CEO) and Erik (CTO) from RWTH research, backed by a €2.8M round led by Vorwerk Ventures, with customers live on our optimization models.

We move fast. We care. No patience for problems left unsolved.

Your mission

Hi, I'm Erik, CTO of Circonomit. This ad is specific on purpose: you should be able to tell from it whether this is your job.

We build decision infrastructure for industrial companies: our customers model their production, with its capacities, costs and constraints, and we compute the answer to "what should we do?" before the decision is made. Our engine turns that model into one artifact that both evaluates like a spreadsheet and optimizes like a solver. It sits between two worlds: the mathematics that makes the answer correct, and the product that has to make it usable by people who are not mathematicians.

That bridge is your mission. You work with our math and OR team to translate real customer problems into models, and you develop the engine that runs them.

We will not sugarcoat it: combinatorial search is unpredictable, customer data arrives messy, and some weeks a deadline sets the priority.

What you'll own

  • Customer models, end to end. Turn a planning problem, with its capacities, costs, lead times and shift plans, into a model whose answer a plant manager acts on. That includes the data it runs on: ERP and Excel exports, and catching the numbers that cannot be right before the c

title: Systemadministrator Linux (m/w/d)
description:
Du willst Systemadministrator Linux nicht einfach administrieren, sondern selbst entscheiden, wie eine moderne Open Source IT Landschaft aussehen soll?🚀

Dann bekommst du hier den Freiraum dafür. Unser Kunde ist ein wachsendes, familiengeführtes Technologieunternehmen aus Freiburg, das Hard- und Softwarelösungen für die industrielle Bildverarbeitung und Automation entwickelt. Die eigenen Systeme kommen heute in mehr als 15.000 Maschinen weltweit zum Einsatz.

Als Systemadministrator Linux verstärkst du einen bewusst klein gehaltenen IT Bereich und bekommst entsprechend viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Statt starrer Konzernstrukturen erwarten dich kurze Wege, direkter Austausch mit der Geschäftsführung und die Möglichkeit, technische Entscheidungen aktiv mitzugestalten. 

Der technologische Fokus liegt konsequent auf Linux und Open Source. In den kommenden Jahren stehen spannende Themen an: bestehende Anwendungen sollen auf Open Source Alternativen migriert, Cyber Security und Resilience weiter ausgebaut und ein eigener interner Linux basierter KI Server kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt werden. 

Wenn Linux dein fachliches Zuhause ist und du lieber neue Lösungen entwickelst, als nur bestehende Systeme am Laufen zu halten, kannst du hier eine IT Landschaft langfristig mitprägen. 

Deine Benefits

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Entscheide aktiv mit, wie sich die interne IT in den Bereichen Linux, Open Source, Cyber Security, Resilience und Automatisierung

title: Customer Success Consultant
description: Je zit aan tafel bij een grote GGZ-instelling. Geen stopwatch die meeloopt, wel de tijd om echt te snappen waar ze tegenaan lopen. Bij CRS krijg je die ruimte. Als Consultant help je onze grootste klanten om meer uit hun EPD te halen, van de dagelijkse praktijk tot de declaraties die de zorg draaiende houden.      Wat ga je doen?    Jij bent het vaste gezicht voor een aantal van onze grootste klanten in de GGZ en Jeugdzorg. Je zorgt dat ze het maximale uit hun EPD halen, van de inrichting tot de dagelijkse praktijk en de declaraties die de zorg draaiende houden. Hoe beter jij ze helpt, hoe soepeler hun behandelaren werken en hoe meer grip ze krijgen op hun geldstroom. Je belangrijkste doel is waarde toevoegen en zorgen dat ze tevreden bij HCI CRS blijven.      Jouw taken:    Je bent het vaste aanspreekpunt en de gesprekspartner voor de grootste klanten: periodieke overleggen, meedenken over hun processen en uitzoeken wat nog niet is gedocumenteerd.  Je begeleidt de uitrol van nieuwe functionaliteiten en helpt klanten die ook echt te gebruiken, zodat de investering zich terugbetaalt.  Als tweede lijn achter de supportdesk pak je de lastigere vragen op en help je klanten inhoudelijk vooruit.  Declaratie- en facturatiestromen naar zorgverzekeraars pluis je uit, zodat klanten meer omzet en betere rapportages uit hun EPD halen.  Klantwensen en bugs leg je vast, je zet ze via DevOps door naar ons productteam en koppelt de status terug. Ook de kennisbank houd je up-to-date.  Je signaleert kansen om de klant verder te helpen en schakelt daarvoor met support, development en sales. Af en toe geef je een demo of webinar.       Over ons    Bij Health Cloud Initiative (HCI) werken ruim 250 collega's aan één doel: betere zorg, makkelijk geregeld. CRS bouwt daarvoor al ruim 25 jaar software voor de GGZ en jeugdzorg, nu met een flinke AI-versnelling. Onze software neemt behandelaren werk uit handen, zodat zij meer tijd overhouden voor hun patiënten. Dat is uiteindelijk waar jouw werk aan bijdraagt.  Je komt in een ervaren, hecht consultancyteam dat nauw samenwerkt met sales. De sfeer is ondernemend en persoonlijk. We werken hard en helpen elkaar, en we lachen net zo makkelijk om onszelf. Voor demo's en implementaties schakel je met sales, en je hebt collega's met veel kennis van de GGZ die hun netwerk en ervaring graag delen. Senior consultant Elianne helpt je op weg en zorgt dat je stap voor stap groeit, net als zij zelf van consultant naar senior is doorgegroeid. Je krijgt de ruimte om te ondernemen, mee te denken en zelf dingen op te pakken.      Wat bieden we jou?     Salaris: € 4.000,-- tot € 5.500,- bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur.  8% vakantiegeld en goede pensioenregeling.  Hybride werken: op onze fijne kantoren   in Wageningen of Amsterdam en 2 dagen vanuit huis.  25 vakantiedagen, de mogelijkheid om 10 dagen bij te kopen.  Reiskostenvergoeding, thuiswerkvergoeding van € 2,45 per dag en thuiswerkplekvergoeding van € 500,- per twee jaar.  Leren &a

description:

 We are B2Spin, and we are dedicated to delivering the best Free-to-Play Social Casino and gaming experiences by creating captivating, engaging, and unique products that are accessible to everyone. We have built a team of talented professionals from all over the globe, who are working to continually improve the experiences of our players. We are not looking to just be part of the industry, but to revolutionize it.     The Role   We run the creative function for retention at a multi-brand iGaming company. That means high-volume, high-frequency output — emails, push notifications, in-app messages, onsite banners — produced for segmented player audiences across multiple brands, all at the same time. This is a marketing creative leadership role, not a product or UX design role. You will lead a team of Digital Designers producing retention marketing assets across four brands and multiple CRM channels — not app or product interfaces.  The Design Team Lead owns the quality and consistency of that output. Not by reviewing everything personally, but by building the systems, standards, and team capability that make good work the default. This is as much an ops-and-systems role as it is a creative leadership role. If you're energized by turning "we eyeball it every time" into "we have a standard for that," this is the job.         What You Will Own    Brand systems that actually get used   Our brands are fragmented today. You'll build the documented visual systems — templates, component libraries, per-brand rules, practical "do this, not that" guidance — that designers reach for rather than work around. When the system is good, consistency stops being something we police and becomes the default.     Repeatable production at scale   Multiple designers producing work across four brands and CRM channels need modular templates, clear briefing standards, and clean versioning. You'll build and maintain those foundations. Just as importantly, you'll convert the feedback you keep repeating into checklists and onboarding material — so nobody gives the same note twice.     AI that produces on-brand results, not surprises   We already use AI heavily; the results aren't predictable enough. You'll put structure around it: per-brand prompt libraries, locked reference styles, clear review checkpoints, and training on how to take a raw AI output and finish it to a genuinely on-brand standard.     Quality that can be measured   You'll define what "on-brand and high quality" means for each brand, track simple signals like first-pass approval rate and rework volume, and catch delivery or quality risks before they hit send dates. You'll also keep improving how the team works — processes, tools, handovers — without waiting to be asked. title: Backend Engineer
description:
About GlassFlow:

GlassFlow is the data infrastructure for AI agents in production. It has two products: GlassFlow Tares, which feeds agents correlated data from every system they touch, and GlassFlow Rius, which traces and debugs what agents do once they're running.

We’re a Berlin startup with a Silicon Valley mentality, backed with $5.9m from Upfront Ventures, the CEO of GitHub, the ex-CTO of Aiven, and more world-class investors.

The founders are serial entrepreneurs with more +10y of experience in building and selling data products.

Tasks

Why is this role special

We are Backend Engineer at GlassFlow, you’ll be shaping the core technology, culture, and trajectory of the company. The code you write will power AI agents for billions of data events around the world.

You’ll be working in a fast, high-ownership environment where speed matters, curiosity is rewarded, and ambition is the norm.

What you’ll do

  • Build and scale high-performance, low-latency systems in Python.
  • Take complete ownership of projects from idea to production.
  • Ship fast, break things, learn, and ship again.
  • Help define the technical culture of GlassFlow.
  • Work directly with the founders to solve problems in a way that no one has solved before.

Requirements

What we’re looking for

You are:

  • Deep expertise in Python.
  • Hungry, competitive, and resilient.
  • Someone with impressive achievements that prove you’re a 10x builder.
  • A fast learner who thrives in chaos.
  • Hands-on, pragmatic, and deeply technical.
  • Actively looking for startup culture.

Previous experience that could be helpful:

  • Experience with public or private clouds (AWS / GCP / Azure)
  • Experience with K8s, Docker, Docker

title: Pulverbeschichter, Oberfächenbeschichter, Lakierer
description:
Unser Kunden ein privat geführtes Unternehmen der Oberflächentechnologie (Galvanisch Verzinken, Feuerverzinken, Nasslack) Hat ein neues Werk für die Pulverbeschichtung errichtet. Das Besondere: hier werden 3-dimensionale Teile bis zu 9 Metern Pulverbeschichtet! Das Werk liegt an der Deutschen Grenze in Österreich. Passau, München und der Kurort Bad Füssing sind in erreichbarer Nähe.

Aufgaben

• Selbstständiges Pulverbeschichten von Metallbauteilen nach Qualitätsvorgaben

• Einstellen und Bedienen der Pulverpistolen bzw. Beschichtungsanlagen

• Vorbereitung, Sichtkontrolle und Beurteilung der zu beschichtenden Bauteile

• Kontrolle der Beschichtungsqualität und Erkennen typischer Beschichtungsfehler

• Durchführung von Farb- und Pulverwechseln sowie sorgfältiger Umgang mit Material und Anlagen

• Einhaltung der internen Qualitäts-, Sicherheits- und Arbeitsvorgaben

Qualifikation

• Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der Pulverbeschichtung ist ideal

• Alternativ: Ausbildung oder fundierte Berufserfahrung als Industrie-, Fahrzeug- oder Lackiertechniker

• Gutes handwerkliches Geschick, saubere und qualitätsbewusste Arbeitsweise

• Technisches Verständnis und selbstständiges Arbeiten

• Gute Deutschkenntnisse für die sichere Kommunikation im Produktionsumfeld

• Bereitschaft zur Arbeit im 2-Schicht-Betrieb

Benefits

Auch sehr gute Industrie- oder Fahrzeuglackierer ohne bisherige Erfahrung in der Pulverbeschichtung sind für uns interessant. Bei passender praktischer Erfahrung und handwerklichem Geschick übernehmen wir die gezielte Einschulung in die Pulverbeschichtung.

Mein Unternehmen vermittelt seit 25 Jahren Fach- und Führungskräfte speziell aus dem Bereich der Oberflächentechnologie (Galvanik, Lack-, Pulver-, KTL Beschichtungen, Feuerverzinkung). Wir sind im D-A-CH Gebiet tätig.

title: Product Manager (DevTools & AI Reliability, remote)
description:
(Fully remote, async-first, DevTools SaaS, 40h/week, time zones: UTC-3 to UTC+3)

The best developers don't wait for a customer to tell them something's broken.

They catch it first, in the pull request, in staging, or in the checkout flow at 3am, before a single user notices. That instinct is Checkly's whole reason to exist. We give developers and their agents the tools to own reliability the way they own their code: monitoring defined as code, powered by OpenTelemetry and Playwright, versioned and reviewed like everything else they ship. From pull request to post-mortem, in one place.

Thousands of them, from modern AI companies like Mistral and resolve.ai to large engineering orgs like LinkedIn, Citi, and 1Password, build with us. Now we need a PM who wants to take that further, in a market being rewritten in real time.

Here's the thing about 2026: AI agents and coding assistants are shipping more software, faster, than any team could review by hand, and more of it is breaking in ways nobody has seen before. LLM-backed features fail probabilistically. Agents take actions no runbook anticipated. "Is my app healthy?" is becoming an unanswerable question for a whole generation of AI-native software. Nobody has really figured out what reliability means for this kind of software yet. That's the problem you'd own.

What you'll do

As a Product Manager, you will be responsible for empowering developers and designers to solve customer problems. You will work directly with our SVP Product Engineering

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who is passionate about Agile and eager to take the first step in their career supported by an experienced Agile team.

Vonage is entering an exciting new chapter, focused on consolidating and aligning a business that has grown and diversified through acquisition. This role will be part of the Lean Agile Center of Excellence (LACE) at Vonage. The LACE are implementing the Scaled Agile framework (SAFe) across the business to help align our teams and maximize the value they deliver. This role is a chance to get real experience of driving SAFe implementation you won’t get from training or certification.

  • Use a data driven approach to help teams monitor their performance and drive a culture of continuous improvement.

title: Senior Product Manager, AI and Endpoint
description:
About Teramind

Teramind is a global leader in workforce intelligence, insider risk management, and data loss prevention. Used by thousands of companies across 60+ countries, our platform gives organizations the visibility to protect their people, their data, and their operations. We sit at the intersection of three converging markets - Insider Risk, DLP, and Workforce Analytics - and we are one of the few players that spans all three on a unified behavioral data layer.

The Teramind Endpoint Agent is one of the key differentiators of our platform. It runs on hundreds of thousands of endpoints across Windows, macOS, and Linux, capturing the behavioral signal that powers our detection, DLP enforcement, analytics, and AI. The depth and quality of what the Agent sees is a primary reason customers choose Teramind over the alternatives - and the product leader who owns it plays a pivotal role in the company's success.

About the Role

We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the Teramind Endpoint Agent, and the AI Usage Control capabilities built on top of it, end to end. You will be the single accountable product leader for the roadmap, priorities, and outcomes of the Agent organization - approximately half of Teramind engineering, working across operating systems, low-level platform components, and the server-side telemetry pipeline. This is a pivotal role. The Agent is one of the strongest competitive moats Teramind has, and the next chapter of the product strategy depends on what we build into it. You are coming in to bring product rigor, customer insight, prioritization discipline, and technical judgment to a team that is capable of shipping world-class endpoint technology. AI Usage Control is one of the most important things you will build here. Companies have spent twenty years governing what employees do with sensitive data, and they now have a second workforce: AI agents reading files, calling tools, and executing commands on the same machines, with none of the accountability. Nobody has worked out what supervising them looks like, and much of it never touches the network, so the endpoint is the only place you can see it. You will own that end to end. You will sit alongside other product managers, reporting to the VP of Product. Together, you own Teramind's product surface area.

What You Will Own

  • The Agent roadmap across all platforms. Windows, macOS, Linux, and the platforms after them. You decide what ships, in what order, and why, balancing customer demand, platform modernization, performance, and security hardening on one prioritized backlog.
  • The endpoint layer of AI Usage Control. Detecting AI that never touches the network - native desktop clients, IDE-embedded assistants, terminal-based coding agents, AI-native Teramind | Senior Product Manager, AI and Endpoint browsers, and local model

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

AEs on the team are charged with accelerating the growth of one or more new product(s) and will be incentivized on quarterly product sales targets mapped to mainline sellers in the segment. These are systems where correctness compounds. The balance of power in the energy industry needs to change. The intermittency of renewable supply and the constant demands of the grid mean that we still rely on less efficient, more expensive and unsustainable fossil fuels to keep the lights on. At Gridfuse, our mission is to shift this balance through technology. To shift the balance of inputs, so that renewables become the world's main source of electricity.

You will own and evolve core parts of the Control services, working closely with other software engineers and our renewable-energy experts.

Whether you aspire to be an entrepreneur or an engineering leader, we believe Palantir is the best place — with the best colleagues — to learn how. title: Operations Manager (m/w/d)
description:
SMARTVÉLO ist ein stark wachsendes Unternehmen für nachhaltige E-Mobilitäts-Lösungen. Wir entwickeln E-Lastenräder, die den urbanen Alltag revolutionieren, und betreiben den Service für unsere Flotten über mehr als 50 Hubs in Deutschland und den Niederlanden. Damit wir bei diesem Tempo die Servicequalität halten, brauchen die operativen Prozesse dahinter eine feste Hand – genau hier kommst Du ins Spiel.

Du berichtest direkt an unseren Head of Operations und verantwortest das operative Tagesgeschäft: Du hältst den Überblick über laufende Projekte, bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für unser über 10-köpfiges Mechaniker-Team im Außendienst und sorgst dafür, dass Informationen zwischen Feld, Lager und Büro sauber fließen.

Wir suchen keine lange Liste an Berufsjahren. Wenn Du strukturiert denkst, gerne Verantwortung übernimmst und Lust auf Operations hast, ist auch der Berufseinstieg bei uns möglich.

Aufgaben

  • Das operative Tagesgeschäft – Du hältst den Betrieb am Laufen, entscheidest im Alltag eigenständig und eskalierst nur, was wirklich eskaliert werden muss
  • Koordination und Kommunikation mit unserem Außendienst-Team – Einsatzabstimmung, Rückfragen, Informationsfluss
  • Tracking kleiner operativer Projekte – Du behältst Fristen, Zuständigkeiten und Status im Blick und treibst diese voran
  • Reporting an den Head of Operations – regelmäßiger, klarer Überblick über Status, Engpässe und Handlungsbedarf
  • Pflege unseres Flottensystems (Papaya) – Fahrzeug-Uploads und Umzüge zwischen den Hubs
  • Vorbereitende KPI-Analysen für Reporting und Entscheidungen
  • Bestand und Verfügbarkeit – Du koordinierst Inventuren und Ersatzteilbestellungen und planst Material und Werkzeug so, dass unsere Mechaniker im Feld nie ohne dastehen
  • Internes Qualitätsmanagement unserer Service-Tickets inkl. Analyse und Datenaufbereitung
  • Reklamationsprozesse von der Aufnahme bis zum Abschluss
  • Flotten

title: Working Student, Website & Organic (m/f/d)
description:
**This position is based in Germany with hybrid or remote working options. Applicants must hold a valid work/residence permit for the respective location.**

Chaos is a leading global software company that provides world-class visualization and design solutions, empowering creative minds to bring ideas to life.

For over twenty years, Chaos has developed innovative technologies serving multiple industries, including architecture and design, media and entertainment, and product e-commerce. Chaos’ solutions help architects, designers, VFX artists/animators, and other creative professionals share ideas, optimize workflows, and create immersive experiences.

Headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany, Chaos is a global company with offices in 11 cities worldwide. In 2022, Chaos and Enscape merged, bringing together two industry-leading companies into one. Since then, Chaos has continued to grow with the additions of Cylindo, AXYZ Design, and Evolve Lab, further expanding our expertise and solutions across architecture, design, e-commerce, and AI. For more information, please visit chaos.com.

Role Overview

The Working Student, Website and Organic contributes to the implementation of Chaos's digital marketing strategy, supporting the Team Lead, Website & Organic in developing the e-commerce platform. The role carries direct ownership of projects related to user research, user experience, and conversion rate optimisation across global web pages, and contributes to building AI-enabled workflows that allow the Website & Organic team to scale its processes. This position is designed for a student looking to develop practical skills within a professional digital environment.

We take it off them. Because none of it is optional, what we are building is infrastructure rather than software, and the purpose is simple: make it cheaper to run a company in Germany.

100 to more than 700 customers in eight months, and still a small team. So these roles are broad by design. You own an area, not a slice of one, there is more to build than there are people, and the scope grows as fast as you do. We work in English internally, as the team is international, but the market is German.

Tasks

You own our sales engine: the team, the numbers and the motions we sell through.

What you inherit on day one. Two sales people, one freelance closer, and everything our COO and CFO has been carrying alongside his actual job. So you are a playing coach for the first months: you carry your own book, you coach two people, and you hire the next ones yourself rather than being handed a team.

Our pipeline today is almost entirely inbound. Outbound is a motion we expect to build, and we do not yet know how large a part of the mix it becomes. We need somebody who has run both, because the answer depends on what you find.

We have deliberately not decided what the sales team should look like. There are too many sensible ways to build one, and the right shape depends on which motions prove out. You design that structure with us and then you hire it, which is why hiring experience is not negotiable in this role.

what you will do

title: Principal AI & Agent Systems Engineer (gn) @ Fusion Energy Venture, Munich
description:
This is an Atlantic portfolio venture.

About the Venture

We are building a new path to fusion energy. Every major leap in human civilisation has followed a breakthrough in energy, from fire to steam to electricity, and we believe fusion is the next one. Our bet is that it will not come from building bigger machines. It will come from controlling matter with enough precision that fusion becomes a manufacturable technology, atoms aligned exactly enough that fusion happens under controlled conditions, on a chip. This is a semiconductor-scale path to clean power, and our stance is precision over brute force. We start in physics and simulation, then build the physical proof. 

About the Role

Reaching a chip-scale approach means working through physics and simulation at a depth that is hard to reach by conventional means, and to do that we need a new class of scientific intelligence. You will work directly with the founders to design that system from the ground up: an AI-driven research platform that can read papers, connect ideas across disciplines, orchestrate simulations, evaluate hypotheses and learn from results. This is not a chatbot or prompt engineering role, and we are not building a foundation model or competing with OpenAI, Anthropic or Google. We believe these systems will need richer representations than today's token-prediction models, so you will help explore new architectures for scientific reasoning, memory, hypothesis generation and autonomous discovery. The better that system works, the faster we get to the physical proof.

What you'll do

title: Onboarding & Technical Support Manager | Legal AI Startup
description: Kleine und mittelständische Kanzleien machen über 90 % des deutschen Rechtsmarkts aus – doch beim Thema KI sind sie auf sich allein gestellt: keine Innovation-Teams, keine Legal Engineers, keine Zeit für monatelange Tool-Evaluierungen. Für sie bauen wir Silvernova: den KI-Associate, der in der Akte des Anwalts denkt und Anwälten täglich bis zu 4 Stunden Arbeitszeit spart. So sind wir in 15 Monaten  von 0 auf 400+ Anwaltskanzleien  und  über 1 Mio. € ARR  gewachsen – nahe Break-even, mit einem Team von 13 Leuten. Hinter uns stehen hochkarätige VCs und Business Angels, darunter Partner renommierter Kanzleien wie YPOG, CMS und Neon. Unser nächster Schritt:  Kanzleienzahl und ARR verzehnfachen.     Und hier kommst du ins Spiel.  Du übernimmst unseren Support und das technische Onboarding in eigener Verantwortung – von der Einrichtung neuer Kanzleien über jede Supportanfrage bis zum System dahinter. Du bist die erste Anlaufstelle für unsere Kunden bei allen technischen und produktbezogenen Fragen – und die Person im Team, die am besten weiß, was unsere Kunden bewegt.   Dabei arbeitest du nicht nur Anfragen ab, sondern machst den Support Woche für Woche besser: Hilfe-Center, Playbooks, KI-gestützte Antworten. Dein Ziel ist, dass dieselbe Frage kein zweites Mal gestellt werden muss – so wächst deine Rolle mit uns, statt in Tickets unterzugehen. Und wenn das Kundenwachstum irgendwann eine zweite Support-Kraft braucht, kommt sie in dein System – und du übernimmst die Verantwortung dafür.   Du arbeitest gerne strukturiert und verlässlich, hast Freude am direkten Draht zu Menschen und willst einen Bereich wirklich zu deinem machen? Dann lass uns sprechen.  Aufgaben     Support in deiner Verantwortung:  Du beantwortest die Supportanfragen unserer Kunden – per E-Mail, Telefon und Videocall. Schnell, freundlich, verbindlich. Du priorisierst selbst, behältst den Überblick und bleibst dran, bis jedes Anliegen gelöst ist. Deine Stärke: verstehen, was passiert ist, und es dem Kunden verständlich erklären.    Technisches Onboarding & Integrationen:  Du richtest neue Kanzleien ein und bringst sie live – inklusive der Anbindung an ihre Kanzleisoftware. Die ersten Einrichtungen pro System machst du hands-on, dokumentierst dabei ein Playbook – und ab dann läuft es nach Checkliste, immer schneller und reibungsloser.    Support-System ausbauen:  Du erkennst Muster in den Anfragen, baust unser Hilfe-Center aus und entwickelst mit uns KI-gestützte Antworten und Automatisierungen. Dein Erfolgsmaßstab: Der Aufwand pro Kunde sinkt, während die Kundenzahl wächst.    Wissen weitergeben:  Deine Erkenntnisse aus dem Kundenkontakt fließen direkt in unsere Academy, unser Agentensystem und die Produktentwicklung – du arbeitest eng mit unseren Legal Engineers zusammen und siehst deine Vorschläge im nächsten Release wieder.    Qualifikation  Wichtiger als dein bisheriger Werdegang ist uns, wie du arbeitest: strukturiert, verlässlich, mit echter Freude am Kundenkontakt.      Abg

title: Support Manager
description: At TOPdesk we help our customers to deliver better services. How? With great software and expert knowledge. Our ever-expanding team has over 700 colleagues in 8 countries, dedicated to making service management more fun and easy. Would you like the freedom to develop your skills in a flexible working environment? A TOPdesk career is the answer.      Vacatureomschrijving     Intro      Onze B2B supportafdeling bestaat uit 25 supporters die klanten dagelijks helpen om zo veel mogelijk uit onze software te halen en storingen snel op te lossen. Al jaren scoren we daarmee gemiddeld een 9,4 op klanttevredenheid, iets waar we trots op zijn. Als Support Manager geef jij leiding aan een team van ongeveer 10 supportmedewerkers en werk je samen met de andere support managers aan de vraag die iedereen nu bezighoudt: hoe zetten we AI zo waardevol mogelijk in om onze processen en dienstverlening naar een hoger niveau te tillen? En minstens zo belangrijk: hoe coach je je team door die verandering heen?      Wat ga je doen als Support Manager?      Samen met de Regional Support Manager NL/BE en de andere support managers werk je aan het doorontwikkelen van de afdeling en onze dienstverlening naar klanten. Jij focust op de supportmedewerkers in Nederland en België, en werkt daarnaast met support managers uit andere landen aan het uniformeren van processen en dienstverlening in alle 7 landen waar TOPdesk supportteams heeft.     Je geeft leiding via individuele coaching en teamoverleg. Je monitort de SLA's en andere KPI's, analyseert trends en identificeert waar nodig verbeterpunten. Loopt de dienstverlening bij een klant niet zoals verwacht? Dan ga jij samen met de accountmanager het gesprek aan. En je geeft mede vorm aan de brede doorontwikkeling van de afdeling: van cultuur en sfeer tot het klaarstomen van je team voor een wereld met AI, en het opzetten van een partnerstrategie waarin support als tweede of derde lijn voor onze partners fungeert.      Waar kom je terecht?      Je werkt vanuit ons kantoor in Delft, met af en toe een bezoek aan Antwerpen. Je maakt onderdeel uit van het Customer domein en rapporteert aan de Regional Support Manager NL/BE. Samen met 2 andere support managers stuur je in totaal 25 ervaren supportmedewerkers aan, in Nederland en een aantal in België.     Inhoudelijk is het team heel sterk en de klant staat er al volop centraal, daar hoef je dus niets aan te veranderen. Bij onze support afdeling werkt een ervaren en inhoudelijk heel sterk team. In alles wat wij doen, staat de klant centraal. Maar tegelijkertijd staat onze afdeling voor een grote uitdaging. Want wat betekent AI voor de baan van onze support medewerkers? Wij geloven dat de banen niet weg gaan, maar inhoudeiljk zullen veranderen. Als manager help jij mee in het vormgeven van deze verandering. Dit doe je samen met support managers in Nederland, en andere landen. Daarnaast werk je samen met 3 support managers uit andere landen aan een gezamenlijke aanpak.           Functi

title: Service Delivery Manager Infra Lokale Overheid
description: Voor PQR in Utrecht en klantlocaties in heel Nederland zoeken wij een Service Delivery Manager Infra - 32–40 uur | Utrecht | hybride       Functie   Als Service Delivery Manager bij PQR ben jij de verbindende schakel tussen onze klanten binnen de lokale overheid en de technische organisatie van PQR. Jij zorgt ervoor dat onze Managed Services niet alleen voldoen aan de gemaakte afspraken, maar daadwerkelijk bijdragen aan een stabiele, veilige en toekomstbestendige IT-omgeving.     Je werkt met gemeenten die midden in hun digitale transformatie zitten. Cloud, security, moderne werkplekken, continuïteit en steeds strengere wet- en regelgeving maken hun IT-landschap complex. Jij brengt daarin overzicht, regie en vooral: rust.       De regisseur van onze dienstverlening    Als Service Delivery Manager ben je verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit en continuïteit van onze dienstverlening bij meerdere klanten binnen de lokale overheid.     Je kent je klanten, begrijpt wat er binnen hun organisatie speelt en weet dit te vertalen naar de dienstverlening van PQR. Daarbij kijk je verder dan SLA's, incidenten en rapportages. Je bespreekt ontwikkelingen, signaleert risico's en verbeterkansen en zorgt ervoor dat onze dienstverlening blijft aansluiten bij de doelen van de klant.     Je schakelt dagelijks tussen klant, engineers, consultants, servicedesk, Managed Services, projectteams en andere specialisten binnen PQR.  Je hoeft daarbij niet zelf de techniek in te duiken, maar je begrijpt IT goed genoeg om de juiste vragen te stellen, prioriteiten te bepalen en technische onderwerpen naar de klant te vertalen.       Werken voor de lokale overheid    Gemeenten worden steeds afhankelijker van IT. Digitale dienstverlening moet beschikbaar zijn, medewerkers moeten veilig en flexibel kunnen werken en tegelijkertijd moeten gemeenten voldoen aan hoge eisen rondom informatiebeveiliging, privacy en continuïteit.  PQR ondersteunt gemeenten onder andere met moderne werkplekken, cloud- en datacenteroplossingen, networking, security en Managed Services.     Als Service Delivery Manager begrijp je deze omgeving. Je weet dat dienstverlening binnen een gemeente andere belangen en dynamiek kent dan binnen een puur commerciële organisatie. Stakeholdermanagement, bestuurlijke gevoeligheid, security, voorspelbaarheid en het nakomen van afspraken zijn hier essentieel.      Wat ga je doen?    Je bent het primaire aanspreekpunt voor een aantal klanten binnen de lokale overheid.  Je bewaakt de kwaliteit, continuïteit en performance van de afgesproken IT-dienstverlening.  Je stuurt op SLA's, KPI's, klanttevredenheid en gemaakte afspraken.  Je organiseert en leidt periodieke service- en voortgangsoverleggen.  Je analyseert rapportages, incidenten, changes en structurele verbeterpunten.  Je vertaalt ontwikkelingen en behoeften bij klanten naar acties binnen PQR.  Je coördineert escalaties en zorgt dat de juiste mensen binnen PQR worden aangehaakt.  Je werkt nauw samen met technische team

title: Service & Onderhoud Manager
description: Voor deze functie zijn wij op zoek naar een Service & Onderhoud Manager die techniek, organisatie en klantgerichtheid moeiteloos samenbrengt. Je stuurt op kwaliteit, klanttevredenheid en efficiency, terwijl je tegelijkertijd oog hebt voor klantbehoeften en commerciële kansen.  Concreet:    Aansturen en coördineren van service- en onderhoudsactiviteiten;  Fungeren als centraal aanspreekpunt voor klanten en interne stakeholders;  Opstellen en opvolgen van offertes en onderhoudscontracten;  Adviseren van klanten over optimalisaties en uitbreidingen;  Signaleren van commerciële kansen bij bestaande klanten en deze vertalen naar concrete acties;  Aansturen en coachen van buitendienstcollega’s;  Bewaken en verbeteren van serviceprocessen;  Monitoren van prestaties en rapporteren richting management.    Wat breng jij mee?  In deze rol breng jij mee:    Technische opleiding (mbo) richting installatietechniek;  Ervaring in service, onderhoud en een coördinerende rol;  Kennis van HVAC, GBS en DDC-systemen;  Leiderschapskwaliteiten en organisatorisch sterk;  Klantgericht en commercieel bewust;  Besluitvaardig en communicatief sterk.  Proactieve en resultaatgerichte instelling.    Waar ga je het doen?  BUILDING technology is een gespecialiseerd technisch bedrijf dat gebouwen slimmer, energiezuiniger en gebruiksvriendelijker maakt. Binnen onze organisatie staat een cultuur van vakmanschap, betrouwbaarheid en samenwerking centraal. Korte lijnen, duidelijke communicatie en verantwoordelijkheid nemen: dát kenmerkt ons als organisatie. Wij maken deel uit van de VDK Installatiegroep, waardoor de voordelen van een grote organisatie worden gecombineerd met de flexibiliteit en dynamiek van een zelfstandig opererend bedrijf.  VDK Installatiegroep – de razendsnel groeiende Topwerkgever van Nederland  BUILDING technology is onderdeel van de VDK

title: Senior Product Designer, Growth
description:
About Vercel:

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company. We free people and agents to ship what’s next.

For more than a decade, Vercel has shaped how the web is built. As the team behind Next.js, v0, and AI SDK, we create products that help builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now, software is entering a new era, and the next generation of products will not just be used by people. They will be built, extended, and operated by agents.

We are building the platform for that future, trusted by companies like OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide. Whether you’re building our products, supporting our customers, growing our community, or shaping our story, you’ll help define what comes next.

About the Role:

You’ll help define Growth Design at Vercel and shape the complete self-serve journey: signup, onboarding, first project and deployment, adoption, conversion, expansion, and retention. The work spans people, agents, and the handoffs between them.

You’ll report into Product Design and work closely with Growth Product, Engineering and Data. You’ll have the authority and support to move from an observed problem to a working prototype, shipped experience, and measured result.

Vercel gives you unlimited access to leading LLMs and in-house tools that make product data easier to explore. If a tool limits the work, you can partner directly with its builders or improve it yourself.

This role does not come with a mature Growth Design playbook, stable briefs, or one bounded product surface. Priorities change as evidence arrives. Some experiments will not ship. Our data and tools allow us to validate hypotheses. You should enjoy finding the right problem, making something real, working through implementation, and staying accountable after launch.

If you’re based within a pre-determined commuting distance of one of our offices (SF, NY, London, or Berlin), the role includes in-office anchor days on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday. title: Projekttechniker/in Blasformen (m/w/d)
description:
Mauser Packaging Solutions ist ein globaler Marktführer von hochwertigen und wegweisenden Verpackungen für industrielle Zwecke. Das Leistungsspektrum umfasst ein vielfältiges Produktportfolio, zu dem Kunststoffverpackungen, Fibertrommeln, Stahlfässer, Intermediate Bulk Container (IBC) in verschiedenen Größen sowie die Rücknahme gebrauchter Verpackungen gehören (Rekonditionierung). Damit bietet Mauser Packaging Solutions einen Komplettservice, der von der Produktion bis zur Wiederverwendung der Verpackungen auf Nachhaltigkeit ausgerichtet ist ("ECO-CYCLE®"). Nach dem Zusammenschluss von BWAY, MAUSER Group, NCG und ICS im Jahr 2018 beliefert Mauser Packaging Solutions mit mehr als 11.000 Beschäftigten an über 180 Standorten namhafte Kunden aus der Chemie, Petrochemie, Landwirtschaft, Pharmaindustrie und der Lebensmittelindustrie.Die Aufgaben und Herausforderungen für MAUSER wachsen.

Aufgaben

  • Unterstützung der Produktionsstandorte bei der Optimierung und Instandhaltung der Produktionsanlagen, insbesondere der Extrusionsblasformmaschinen
  • Durchführung von Maßnahmen zur Vermeidung oder Reduktion von Stillstandszeiten
  • Leitung von Projekten zur Durchführung von Reparaturen, Überholungen und Verlagerung von Produktionsanlagen; Erstellen von Termin- und Kostenplänen
  • Handwerkliche Arbeit bei Montage / Demontage / Reparatur von Maschinenkomponenten
  • Reinigung / Begutachtung von Bauteilen und bei Bedarf Einholen und Abstimmen von Angeboten
  • Koordination von internen und externen Lieferanten im Hinblick auf eine sachgemäße Durchführung der Arbeiten und die Minimierung der Stillstandszeiten in Koordination mit der Produktionsplanung bzw. der Leitung des betroffenen Standortes
  • Bewertung und Dokumentation von Maschinenzuständen sowie der daraus abzuleitenden Maßnahmen und Verwaltung eines entsprechenden Datenbestandes
  • Erstellung von Lastenheften
  • Erstellung von systematischen Wartungsplänen

title: Account Executive - Mid-market
description:
about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

What makes this company unique is its ambition: to become the first truly scalable business in a sector that has historically been fragmented, craft-based, and impossible to systematise. title: Technical Product Lead - AI Investing
description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. title: Projekttechniker/in Blasformen (m/w/d)
description:
Mauser Packaging Solutions ist ein globaler Marktführer von hochwertigen und wegweisenden Verpackungen für industrielle Zwecke. Das Leistungsspektrum umfasst ein vielfältiges Produktportfolio, zu dem Kunststoffverpackungen, Fibertrommeln, Stahlfässer, Intermediate Bulk Container (IBC) in verschiedenen Größen sowie die Rücknahme gebrauchter Verpackungen gehören (Rekonditionierung). Damit bietet Mauser Packaging Solutions einen Komplettservice, der von der Produktion bis zur Wiederverwendung der Verpackungen auf Nachhaltigkeit ausgerichtet ist ("ECO-CYCLE®"). Nach dem Zusammenschluss von BWAY, MAUSER Group, NCG und ICS im Jahr 2018 beliefert Mauser Packaging Solutions mit mehr als 11.000 Beschäftigten an über 180 Standorten namhafte Kunden aus der Chemie, Petrochemie, Landwirtschaft, Pharmaindustrie und der Lebensmittelindustrie.Die Aufgaben und Herausforderungen für MAUSER wachsen.

Aufgaben

  • Unterstützung der Produktionsstandorte bei der Optimierung und Instandhaltung der Produktionsanlagen, insbesondere der Extrusionsblasformmaschinen
  • Durchführung von Maßnahmen zur Vermeidung oder Reduktion von Stillstandszeiten

  • Handwerkliche Arbeit bei Montage / Demontage / Reparatur von Maschinenkomponenten
  • Reinigung / Begutachtung von Bauteilen und bei Bedarf Einholen und Abstimmen von Angeboten
  • Koordination von internen und externen Lieferanten im Hinblick auf eine sachgemäße Durchführung der Arbeiten und die Minimierung der Stillstandszeiten in Koordination mit der Produktionsplanung bzw. der Leitung des betroffenen Standortes
  • Bewertung und Dokumentation von Maschinenzuständen sowie der daraus abzuleitenden Maßnahmen und Verwaltung eines entsprechenden Datenbestandes
  • Erstellung von Lastenheften
  • Erstellung von systematischen Wartungsplänen

At Tiger Data, formerly Timescale, we empower developers and businesses with the fastest PostgreSQL platform designed for transactional, analytical, and agentic workloads. Trusted globally by thousands of organizations, Tiger accelerates real-time insights, drives intelligent applications, and powers critical infrastructure at scale. As a globally distributed, remote-first team committed to direct communication, accountability, and collaborative excellence, we're shaping the future of data infrastructure, built for speed, flexibility, and simplicity.

Toolkit Engineer

As a toolkit Engineer, you'll own one of the most important touchpoints developers have with TimescaleDB. TimescaleDB toolkit provides an additive set of hyperfunctions enabling users to offload complex calculations into the database, transforming raw time-series data into production-ready insights. You'll shape the roadmap, identify what should be built next, and deliver developer experiences that help engineers solve increasingly complex problems across industrial IoT, manufacturing, observability, financial markets, and beyond.

title: Asiakaspalvelutiimin esihenkilö
description: Asiakaspalvelutiimin esihenkilöksi?       Meistä      Storia Oy on yli satavuotias suomalainen logistiikkatalo. Olemme ulkoistetun logistiikan-, ja tukkumyyntialan pioneeri. Toimitamme asiakkaillemme yli 20 miljoonaa tuotetta vuosittain. Olemme kirjamaailman logististen palvelujen edelläkävijä, ja verkkokauppapalvelujen kehittäjä. Toimintamme ulottuu varastoinnin ulkoistamisesta toimituksiin, laskutukseen ja rahaliikenteen hallintaan. Digitaaliset lisäpalvelumme, kuten verkkokauppa-alusta, tukevat asiakkaitamme heidän liiketoiminnassaan. Haluamme olla asiakkaidemme ensisijainen liiketoimintakumppani. Haluamme kasvaa liiketoiminnassamme, ja laajentaa toimintaamme uusiin asiakasryhmiin.        Tehtävästä      Asiakaspalvelutiimin esihenkilönä olet avainroolissa viemässä asiakaspalveluamme seuraavaan vaiheeseen. Tavoitteenamme on asiakaspalvelu, joka hallitsee asiantuntijana palveluketjun kokonaisuutta, hyödyntää ajantasaisia toimintamalleja, tekee laadukasta ja itsenäistä asiakastyötä. Storian asiakaspalvelu toimii asiakkaan arjen etulinjassa ja on tärkeä osa palveluketjumme laatua, sujuvuutta ja asiakaskokemusta. Tehtävässä johdat tiimiä, jonka työssä yhdistyvät monikanavainen asiakaspalvelu, asiakkuuksien hoito, reklamaatioiden ja ongelmatilanteiden ratkaisu, järjestelmien käytön neuvonta sekä tiivis yhteistyö liiketoimintojen, hallinnon tukitoimintojen, ja asiakkaiden kanssa.      Arkesi asiakaspalvelutiimin esihenkilönä?       Vastaat asiakaspalvelutiimin päivittäisen työn sujumisesta, työn organisoinnista ja tehtävien jakamisesta.  Toimit tiimin esihenkilönä ja hoidat työsuhteen elinkaareen liittyviä asioita.   Motivoit, tuet ja kehität tiimiä kohti tavoitteellista, laadukasta ja asiantuntevaa asiakaspalvelutyötä.  Osallistut asiakaspalvelutyöhön ja pysyt kiinni tiimin arjessa, asiakasrajapinnan tilanteissa ja palveluketjun toimivuudessa.  Seuraat asiakaspalvelun laatua, asiakastyytyväisyyttä ja sovittuja mittareita, kuten vastausaikoja, palvelutasoa, asiakasmääriä, poikkeamia ja reklamaatioita.   Rakennat sujuvaa yhteistyötä sisäisten sidosryhmien kanssa ja viet eteenpäin palveluketjun kehittämistä sekä asiakkaiden että liiketoiminnan näkökulmasta.       Mitä toivomme sinulta?       Hyvää ymmärrystä palveluketjusta ja sen kehittämisestä, asiakkuuksista ja asiakaspalvelutyön merkityksestä liiketoiminnalle.  Halua ja kykyä johtaa tiimiä arjen tilanteissa läsnä olevalla, rakentavalla ja tavoitteellisella otteella.  Kykyä hahmottaa kokonaisuuksia, ratkaista ongelmia ja viedä asioita eteenpäin.  Hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja viestintätaitoja sekä pelisilmää toimia asiakkaiden, tiimin ja sisäisten sidosryhmien kanssa.  Paineensietokykyä, palautteen antamisen ja vastaanottamisen taitoa sekä halua vahvistaa avointa ja luottamuksellista työilmapiiriä.  Kehitysmyönteisyyttä, oma-aloitteisuutta ja kiinnostusta asiakaspalvelun toimintamallien, järjestelmien ja osaamisen kehittämiseen. Global Impact    世界22拠点以上で展開するグローバル企業のCRM戦略に携われます。  Strategic Ownership    戦略策定だけでなく、実行・分析・改善までオーナーシップを持って推進できます。  Innovation    Brazeを中心にAIや最新マーケティングテクノロジーを積極活用しています。  International Environment    海外チームとの日常的な協業を通じてグローバルなキャリアを築けます。  Meaningful Customer Experience    世界中の富裕層会員に対し、特別な体験を届けるサービスに携われます。   Working Arrangement     Location  Tokyo Office (Hybrid)   Working Hours   Monday - Friday  9:00am - 6:00pm  ※ 月に1〜2回程度、APAC・UKチームとの会議のため夜間ミーティングが発生する場合があります。     Benefits    Benefits      社会保険完備    ハイブリッド勤務（試用期間終了後、週2〜3日在宅勤務可）    産前産後休暇    育児休暇制度    介護休暇制度    勤続表彰休暇制度    5年・10年勤続時には最長1か月の特別休暇取得可能    オフィス内スナック・ドリンク無料     Interested?    まずはカジュアル面談からでも歓迎です。  「グローバルな環境でCRM戦略をリードしたい」  「Brazeを活用して顧客体験を進化させたい」  「日本市場だけでなくAPAC全体に影響を与えたい」  そんな方からのご応募をお待ちしています。   ご参考までに、Tenの動画をご覧ください。こちらをクリックしてください。  カジュアル面談も可能です！面接前にご質問がございましたら、お気軽にお聞かせください。

description: 쏘카 차량서비스팀을 소개합니다     차량서비스팀은 쏘카를 이용하는 모든 순간의 차량 상태를 책임집니다. 데이터 기반의 운영 개선과 정책 설계로 세차·위생 품질을 고도화하고, 사용자에게 더 나은 이동 경험을 제공합니다.   또한 장소의 제약 없이 카셰어링을 이용할 수 있도록, 차량을 고객이 원하는 위치로 배달하고 회수하는 핸들러 운영을 총괄합니다.  이번 포지션은 세차·위생 협력사 관리와 핸들러 운영을 함께 담당하며, 두 영역을 아우르는 운영 체계와 품질 기준을 만들어갑니다.     담당하시게 될 업무를 소개합니다     협력사 운영 및 성과 관리 (세차·위생)  차량 서비스(세차, 위생 등) 품질 유지를 위한 협력사 운영 모델 수립  계약·단가 협의, KPI/SLA 정의 및 품질 모니터링  거점·현장 실사를 통한 수행 품질 점검과 개선 과제 도출  핸들러 운영  차량을 고객이 원하는 위치로 배달·회수하는 핸들러 운영 전반 관리  적시 배달률(도착 지연) 개선 - 지연 원인 분석, 운영 기준·알림 체계 정비  핸들러 공급 관리 - 배차 수락률·매칭률 모니터링과 공급 부족 구간 대응  단가·할증(인센티브) 정책 설계 - 공급이 필요한 시간·지역으로 배차 유도  운영 정책 및 프로세스 고도화  현장 이슈(분실물, 차량 위생 장애, 배달 지연 등) 대응 프로세스의 구조화  지연·이상 상황 감지 알림과 에스컬레이션(CS·협력사·핸들러) 체계 설계·운영  운영 기준 문서화 및 반복 업무 자동화 과제 발굴  데이터 기반 운영 개선  빅쿼리(BigQuery)를 활용한 핵심 지표 모니터링 (적시성·품질·건당 비용)  운영상의 Pain Point 분석을 통한 개선 시나리오 수립과 예상 효과 산정  사업 및 프로덕트 부서와 협력하여 서비스 운영 시스템의 기능 개선 및 정책 반영     이런 분과 함께 성장하고 싶습니다     운영 기획 또는 공급망·파트너 운영 경력 5년 이상 (협력사 계약·단가·품질 관리, 또는 배송·물류·플랫폼 등 공급자 네트워크 운영 경험)  SQL(BigQuery)로 필요한 데이터를 직접 추출하고 지표를 검증할 수 있는 분 (조인·집계 활용 수준)  데이터로 문제를 정의하고 정책·프로세스 변경으로 연결해 본 분  Google Workspace 및 MS Office 활용 능력이 우수한 분  운전면허(2종 보통 이상) 보유 및 실제 운행 가능하신 분     이런 분이면 더욱 좋습니다     A/B 테스트·파일럿을 설계하고 결과를 해석해 정책 의사결정에 활용해 본 경험이 있는 분  단가·인센티브 구조를 설계하고 건당 비용 등 유닛 이코노믹스를 관리해 본 경험이 있는 분  AI 도구(Claude, ChatGPT 등)나 RPA로 반복 업무를 직접 자동화해 본 경험이 있는 분 (리포트·대시보드·데이터 정리 등)  파이썬 등을 활용한 데이터 처리·자동화 경험이 있는 분  공유 모빌리티 또는 관련 온·오프라인 연계 서비스(O2O) 종사 경험이 있는 분  현장 인력·거점 운영 등 오프라인 운영을 직접 관리해 본 경험이 있는 분  정책·전략 문서를 논리적으로 작성하고 내부 설득에 활용한 경험이 있는 분     미래의 쏘팸이 되기 위한 과정    서류 전형 → 1차(직무) 인터뷰 → 2차(컬쳐 핏) 인터뷰  → 입사 조건 협의(처우, 입사일) → 최종 합격 확정 → 입사     처우 협의가 완료된 후보자 분들께 최종 합격 안내를 드리고 있습니다.  후보자 혹은 회사의 상황에 따라 전형이 추가될 수 있습니다.  입사 후 3개월의 수습 평가 기간이 있습니다.     지원하시기 전에 꼭 읽어 주세요!     각 전형 결과는 지원 시 기재해주신 이메일 주소로 안내 드릴 예정입니다.  채용 관련 문의는 talent@socar.kr으로 보내주시기 바랍니다.  제출해주신 지원서 내용 중 허위 사실이 있는 경우 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.  해당 공고는 수시 채용으로, 채용 완료 시 조기 마감 될 수 있습니다.  국가유공자 및 장애인 등 취업 보호 대상자는 관계 법령에 따라 우대합니다.     👀   채용 중인 쏘카의 포지션 한눈에 보기

description: Vil du være med å videreutvikle Agrias salgssenter?      Agria er markedsleder innen dyreforsikring i Norge og en av Europas største aktører innen sitt felt. Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.

AI doesn’t work without real-world, contextualized data - Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.

In 1905, chief engineer John Stevens inherited one of the most ambitious infrastructure projects in history: the Panama Canal.

The challenge wasn’t digging a ditch between two oceans. It was figuring out how to move ships safely through a system of locks, gates, reservoirs, and changing conditions without bringing global commerce to a halt.

The solution wasn’t to stop movement. It was to create a framework that allowed movement at scale.

Modern financial infrastructure presents a similar challenge. Payment systems, banking products, compliance obligations, and regulatory frameworks all exist for a reason. The goal isn’t to eliminate complexity. It’s to build systems that allow innovation, growth, and customer value within it.

Since 2019, Mercury has been on a mission to reinvent banking‡ for the modern age. We blend elegant design and cutting-edge technology to offer checking and savings accounts, debit cards, payment services, credit products, cash management tools, and sophisticated analytics. Everything we build reflects our belief that financial products should be thoughtfully crafted, fast, transparent, and genuinely enjoyable to use.

As we continue expanding and iterating on our product offerings and as we work to build a nationally chartered bank, we’re looking for a Counsel, Product & Regulatory (Payments & AML) to help us navigate increasingly complex questions at the intersection of product, regulation, and financial infrastructure.

Our Product & Regulatory Legal team operates like the rest of Mercury: with urgency, curiosity, and a bias toward action.

We embed with product teams from early ideation through launch, working alongside engineers, designers, compliance partners, operations teams, and risk stakeholders to get products right. We move fast, we take ownership, and we don’t wait to be asked. If something needs figuring out, we’re up to the task.

We are not a team that sits on the sidelines reviewing finished proposals. We work alongside our partners to identify risks, unlock opportunities, and find practical paths forward. We care deeply about good judgment, strong relationships, and building frameworks that scale.

title: Service Delivery Manager
description: Als Service Delivery Manager bij Circular IT group ben je verantwoordelijk voor een aantal klanten en de dienstverlening die we voor hen leveren.     Je zorgt dat afspraken worden nagekomen, houdt overzicht en schakelt met de teams die het werk uitvoeren. Je zit er bovenop als iets niet loopt en zorgt dat het wordt opgelost.     Je bent voor klanten het vaste aanspreekpunt en weet wat er speelt. Tegelijkertijd zie je waar dingen beter kunnen en pak je dat op.      Wat ga je doen?    Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de dienstverlening richting jouw klanten  SLA’s worden door jou bewaakt en opgevolgd  Je schakelt met operations, logistiek en support  Issues signaleer je en los je op met de juiste teams  Service reviews bereid je voor en voer je uit  Je draagt verbeteringen aan in processen en samenwerking  Je houdt overzicht en zorgt dat acties worden opgepakt       Wie ben jij?    HBO werk- en denkniveau  Ervaring met servicemanagement of een vergelijkbare rol  Overzicht houden in een omgeving waar meerdere teams en processen samenkomen  Ervaring met SLA’s en het bewaken van serviceafspraken  Duidelijk en direct communiceren, ook als iets niet loopt zoals afgesproken  Structuur aanbrengen en zorgen dat afspraken worden nagekomen  Verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor de kwaliteit van dienstverlening  In staat om teams en klanten mee te krijgen in wat nodig is       Wat bieden wij?    Een salaris tussen €4.250 en €5.000 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van ervaring.  Een leaseauto of volledige reiskosten vergoeding.  Standplaats Nieuwegein met de mogelijkheid tot thuiswerken.  Een rol waarin je direct invloed hebt op hoe nieuwe klanten starten bij Circular IT group.  24 vakantiedagen en een laptop en telefoon van de zaak.  Deelname aan onze vrijwillige pensioenregeling met volledige eigen bijdrage  Samenwerken met teams uit verschillende onderdelen van de organisatie, van sales tot operations.      In het kader van de Wet Bevordering Participatie en Diversiteit nodigen wij nadrukkelijk kandidaten van diverse achtergronden uit om te solliciteren. Wij geloven in de kracht van een inclusieve werkomgeving en streven ernaar om kansen te bieden aan iedereen, ongeacht leeftijd, geslacht, afkomst, geloof, of beperking. Samen werken we aan een diverse en innovatieve werkplek waar iedereen zich thuis voelt.     Wil jij deel uitmaken van een groeiend bedrijf waar je écht impact maakt?  Solliciteer nu en versterk ons team in Nieuwegein!

Our marketplace connects parents with childcare providers. Our software and services help providers reach families, manage their programs, and operate more effectively. We also work with employers that want to help their employees find childcare.  Wonderschool is a Series B company backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Goldman Sachs, and First Round Capital. Work with product and engineering to address underlying causes and verify that solutions work.     Make the Marketplace Work     Help more families successfully connect with childcare providers. Establish consistent training and cross-training practices to strengthen team capabilities, business continuity, and customer responsiveness

title: Customer Operations Specialist (B2B)
description: Ben jij iemand die graag contact heeft met klanten, overzicht houdt en het leuk vindt om processen steeds slimmer in te richten? Werk je graag met systemen en data, zonder dat je een IT-specialist bent? Dan is deze functie iets voor jou.     Als Customer Operations Specialist zorg jij ervoor dat onze Wholesale (B2B) klanten soepel met ons kunnen samenwerken. Jij bent het aanspreekpunt voor vragen over data en digitale koppelingen en zorgt ervoor dat alles achter de schermen goed geregeld is.     Je begeleidt nieuwe klanten bij de inrichting van de samenwerking, houdt datastromen in de gaten en lost eventuele verstoringen op. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met Sales, Customer Service en IT. Jij hoeft geen koppelingen te programmeren, maar begrijpt wel hoe systemen samenwerken en vindt het leuk om uit te zoeken waar iets misgaat. Door jouw klantgerichte instelling en analytisch vermogen zorg je voor een optimale samenwerking met onze klanten én help je processen continu te verbeteren.      Dagelijks houd jij je bezig met:    Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor klanten met vragen over data-uitwisseling en digitale koppelingen.   Je begeleidt de onboarding van nieuwe wholesale klanten en zorgt ervoor dat de digitale samenwerking goed wordt ingericht.   Je bewaakt de kwaliteit van data en signaleert afwijkingen of verstoringen.   Je onderzoekt problemen en zorgt samen met collega's voor een passende oplossing.   Je stemt af met Sales, Customer Service en IT om klantvragen snel en goed op te lossen.   Je denkt actief mee over hoe processen slimmer, efficiënter en klantvriendelijker kunnen.   Je signaleert terugkerende knelpunten en komt met verbetervoorstellen.   Je helpt mee om onze B2B-processen verder te professionaliseren.        Dit breng jij mee:    HBO werk- en denkniveau.   Ervaring in een klantgerichte binnendienst-, operations- of supportfunctie.   Je vindt het leuk om met systemen en data te werken.   Je bent analytisch en zoekt graag uit waar een probleem vandaan komt.   Je kunt goed schakelen tussen klanten en interne collega's.   Je werkt nauwkeurig, gestructureerd en denkt in oplossingen. But the highest-value work is not a purchase order. It is the first-look arrangement that keeps a category away from a competitor. The revenue share that turns a cost line into a business. The co-sell motion that puts a partner's sellers in front of our buyers, and ours in front of theirs. The acquisition thesis that says this supply is too strategic to rent.  You are equally comfortable interrogating an evaluation result and negotiating a term sheet — you design the proof that tells us whether a partner's data is actually net-new, build the business case, and run the commercial conversation to close.   • Ausbildung: Du absolvierst ein Studium im Bereich Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Personalmanagement, Psychologie oder bringst eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit.

title: Senior Solutions Engineer
description:
Senior Solutions Engineer — EMEA

At Phrase, we help open the door to global business by providing the world's leading Language Intelligence Platform.

The Phrase Platform combines AI, agentic orchestration, and a headless, API-first architecture in one composable system. Beyond translation, it orchestrates and adapts content to culture, audience, channel, brand voice, and intended outcome in any language, for every audience. It applies the context that makes content perform in every market: quality standards, glossaries, prior translations, and cultural nuance. Every team, in every region, can ship content that is on-brand, on-point, and ready for any audience.

Phrase gives enterprises the intelligence to automate workflows, the freedom to connect their own tools and engines, and the control to govern global content at scale.

With a global team based in our offices, and remote colleagues across Europe, the UK, the US, and the APAC region, Phrase offers an international environment built on collaboration, innovation, and shared purpose.

This is a senior individual contributor role, reporting to the VP of Solutions Engineering. You will be working hand in hand with Enterprise AEs across EMEA, running discovery, building the business case and delivering demos and Proof of Value workshops that actually connect to what's keeping a customer's business up at night.

We're building an AI-first pre-sales organisation where continuous improvement is part of everyone's role. You'll be encouraged to challenge how things are done, use AI and automation to remove repetitive work and help create smarter ways of working for the whole team. If your instinct is to ask "there must be a better way" and then go and build it, you'll thrive here.

title: Language Lead - French (Contract)
description:
About Cartesia

Our mission is to architect AI that learns from and interacts with the world like humans do.

We're pioneering the model architectures that will make this possible. Our founding team met as PhDs at the Stanford AI Lab, where we invented State Space Models or SSMs, a new primitive for training efficient, large-scale foundation models. Our team combines deep expertise in model innovation and systems engineering paired with a design-minded product engineering team to build and ship cutting edge models and experiences.

We're funded by leading investors at Index Ventures and Lightspeed Venture Partners, along with Factory, Conviction, A Star, General Catalyst, SV Angel, Databricks and others. We're fortunate to have the support of many amazing advisors, and 90+ angels across many industries, including the world's foremost experts in AI.

Overview

We are seeking native-level French speakers with a linguistics background to serve as the primary language resource for voice AI in their language. You will be the trusted point of contact for all questions, quality decisions, and language-specific work related to French.

This is not a standard annotation engagement. You will own your language end to end, which includes managing annotation quality, auditing data, monitoring product performance, investigating customer-reported issues, and executing projects that require deep linguistic expertise and attention to detail. You will operate independently across these workstreams and serve as the team's go-to resource for anything related to your language.

This is an ongoing contractor engagement. Availability during some US Pacific business hours is preferred to allow for team syncs and real-time support.

title: Chief Operating Officer
description:
About iSpeedToLead

iSpeedToLead is the leading pay-per-lead marketplace for real estate wholesalers, investors, and agents in the US. We sell motivated seller leads with no subscriptions and no contracts. Bootstrapped, profitable, $15M+ ARR, ~50 people across Europe, the Middle East, Asia, and the US. We move fast, we measure everything, and we are building for a much bigger outcome.

Why this role exists

The CEO is doing two jobs: setting strategy and running day-to-day operations. Your job is to take the second one and run it better than he does. You own execution across the whole company so the CEO can focus on product vision, new verticals, and growth bets.

What you will own

• The operating system of the company: department goals, KPIs, weekly scoreboards, and accountability across Supply, Demand, and Marketplace teams

• Department heads: run their cadence, remove blockers, make sure every leader hits their two core KPIs with hard guardrails against metric gaming

• P&L discipline: unit economics per department, cost caps, and a clear path to our monthly net profit target

• Cross-team execution: when a launch needs Supply, Demand, and Product working together, you make it happen on time

The Team   Our diverse  Services  business provides 24/7 servicing for: hospitals, utilities, data centres, support for the resources sector and just about everything in-between. Our Schneider Electric portfolio covers UPS, critical cooling equipment, LV/MV switchgear, transformers, substation monitoring as well as a wide range of ancillary equipment. We enable owners, end users and custodians to minimise breakdowns, increase reliability, efficiency and safety while reducing costs and simplifying operations.   The Opportunity   Our  Services  team is growing and with growth comes opportunity. We are currently seeking an experienced  Service Delivery Manager  to be join our VIC/SA team. Based in  Melbourne , you will bring your proven leadership experience and technical knowledge to lead others across our  Secure Power  (think Uninterruptible Power Supply, Batteries etc.),  Power   Systems  (Switchgear, Circuit Breakers etc.) and  Cooling  teams.  You will get the opportunity to lead a passionate team of specialist Service Representatives who are  “Wired Differently”.  They get up early, travel far and tackle the toughest problems on the fly. They thrive on independence, problem-solving and making a real impact – every single day.   Key responsibilities will see you:     Utilising your skills and experience to lead a team of Service Representatives across our growing Victorian and South Australian operations   Managing team performance, development and ensuring that resources are utilised in a way that enhances delivery as you utilise Schneider tools and adhere to set processes  Frequently interacting with our Customers, focusing on account management and the development of new business opportunities within a market that is full of opportunity   Collaborating with a variety of key stakeholders to drive Customer outcomes and ensure ongoing growth and success across a variety of emerging markets  Playing a key technical role and acting as a role model when it comes to best practice across; systems, internal processes and the utilisation of tools that support a digitally focused organisation   Providing regular reporting and insights in relation to; project status, business performance, financials and other key metrics   Contributing to workforce planning, the management of Subcontractor resources, involvement in special projects and leading other proactive business improvement initiatives  Role modelling HSE, Quality and committed to nurturing future talent through our Apprentices and the broader development of your team     Our ideal candidate will possess:     Relevant tertiary qualifications (Electrician or similar Technical Trade) coupled with proven experience in a similar leadership position  Proven leadership capabilities
