title: Manager, Operational Services (Onboard Customer Service)
description: You’ll connect Queensland. We’ll connect you to an amazing career.   At Queensland Rail, connection is at the heart of everything we do—and it starts with you. Our Travel network links communities across the state, delivering unforgettable tourism experiences and essential journeys for work, family, and care.  Learn more about Queensland Rail's purpose, people and progress - watch our short video here.   About The Role   Our Operational Services Team play a crucial role in supporting our Onboard and Station Customer Service division through the management of master rosters, training, audits, compliance and system improvements.  As the Operational Services Manager - Onboard Customer Service, you’ll lead a team of eight to develop and implement systems, projects, processes and operational frameworks that enhance service delivery, strengthen business performance and ensure our onboard teams are equipped to provide exceptional customer service.  This is a  temporary full-time position until October 2027  which is based at Platform 10, Roma Street Station however for the right candidate there is flexibility for this position to be based at one of our other depots in Bundaberg, Rockhampton, Townsville or Cairns.   What you’ll be doing:       Lead and manage the Operational Services team, fostering a high-performance and collaborative culture   Provide strategic leadership in a dynamic transport and tourism environment, building strong partnerships and driving commercial and customer-focused outcomes   Contribute as a member of the Onboard Customer Service Leadership Team to achieve business objectives, drive growth initiatives and enhance the customer experience across long-distance services   Oversee rostering, time administration and training functions to support service delivery   Manage customer service support activities across the state, working with employees and contracted service providers to deliver consistent service outcomes   Partner with stakeholders to develop and implement hospitality, customer service and presentation standards through training, coaching and continuous improvement   Lead system enhancements, back-of-house improvements, compliance programs, auditing processes and training initiatives   Support the delivery of Travel and Tourism strategies by providing innovative solutions, stakeholder engagement and expert advice to improve onboard products and systems   Maintain and continuously improve onboard customer service standards, hospitality functions and service delivery processes   Lead the development and implementation of key projects, programs, change initiatives and strategies that improve business performance, customer experience and commercial outcomes     Responsibilities   For full position responsibilities please read this  Position Description.     Benefits that count:       Base annual salary of $151,359 (pro-rata)   Work predominately between 8am to 4pm Monday to Friday with flexibility to work additional hour

title: Principal Customer Success Manager, Strategic DACH
description: Overview    Working at Atlassian   Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity. title: VP, Customer Success
description: This is a remote-friendly role. Ideally, candidates will sit in the following states: AL, AZ, CA, CO, DC, DE, FL, GA, ID, IL, LA, MA, MO, NC, NH, NJ, NV, NY, OR, OH, PA, RI, SC, TX, VA, WA, WI.    At this time, Tapcheck does not provide sponsorship for employment-based visas (e.g., H-1B, L-1, TN, etc.). Therefore, candidates must already possess the right to work in the United States without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future.    About The Job   The VP, Customer Success is the executive owner of Tapcheck's entire post-sale organization: Customer Support, Onboarding, Customer Success, Account Management, and Payment Operations. Reporting to the COO, you will audit the current state of each function, then architect and lead the strategy that carries Tapcheck through its next phase of growth: scaling high-volume support, rebuilding the CSM motion, standing up a proactive Account Management and expansion engine, and tying every decision back to retention and revenue.  This role is for a leader who has built these functions before and wants to build them again with real ownership. In our B2B2C model, we win the employer, then we win adoption, engagement, and trust with their employees. You'll set direction across four functions at different maturity levels while developing a team of managers who run the day-to-day. You will not own individual accounts. Early on, expect to be hands-on: sitting in on executive customer relationships and save conversations, and working alongside your managers to establish the right playbooks and standards. As the team matures and your managers grow into their roles, your involvement shifts from doing the work to coaching the people who do it. title: Head of Customer Growth
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Customer Growth based in Germany.   As Head of Customer Growth, you will build and lead a comprehensive operating system designed to help customers become stronger, more successful businesses. You will oversee a multi-lane function spanning Customer Success, Growth Advisory, Growth Advocacy, and Customer Enablement, setting the strategy, operating model, talent standards, and investment priorities. The role combines strategic account leadership, customer growth expertise, product adoption, education, and scalable enablement. You will determine where high-touch support can create the greatest impact while developing scalable solutions for the broader customer base. Working closely with Product, Sales, Marketing, Support, Data, and technical teams, you will turn customer insights into measurable improvements. This is a high-impact leadership opportunity in a remote-first environment, working with a diverse global customer base and a rapidly evolving digital product ecosystem.  Accountabilities    Own the Customer Growth strategy: Define how customers are supported throughout their lifecycle, from high-value strategic accounts and high-potential customers to specialist-assisted, scaled, and long-tail segments.  Build segmentation and coverage models: Use customer value, future potential, product adoption, intent, growth opportunities, risk, and strategic importance to determine the right level and type of support.  Lead through the CSM Team Lead: Establish high standards for account strategy, customer context, stakeholder management, growth diagnosis, adoption planning, commercial awareness, and execution while developing a strong leadership bench.  Identify high-potential customers early: Partner with Data, Product, Sales, Marketing, and Support to identify customers with significant future potential before revenue alone makes them obvious.  Govern Growth Advisory: Create clear processes for intake, qualification, expected impact, quality, follow-through, and knowledge reuse, ensuring specialist expertise is deployed against specific high-value challenges.  Develop Growth Advocacy: Turn customer insights and proven practices into authoritative, scalable education for customers and the wider ecosystem.  Build Customer Enablement and scaled growth: Develop lifecycle programs, templates, office hours, documentation, automation, product nudges, and eventually next-best-action guidance.  Drive meaningful product adoption: Work with Product and Product Marketing to ensure customers adopt capabilities that genuinely improve their outcomes rather than simply increasing feature usage.  Establish cross-functional decision rights: Clarify how Customer Growth works with Sales, Technical Account Management, Support, Product, Marketing, and Data to ensure effective collaboration and clear ownership. title: Full-Stack Software Engineer, Internal Services
description:
At Serve Robotics, we’re reimagining how things move in cities. Our personable sidewalk robot is our vision for the future. It’s designed to take deliveries away from congested streets, make deliveries available to more people, and benefit local businesses.

The Serve fleet has been delighting merchants, customers, and pedestrians along the way in Los Angeles, Miami, Dallas, Atlanta and Chicago while doing commercial deliveries. We’re looking for talented individuals who will grow robotic deliveries from surprising novelty to efficient ubiquity.

Who We Are

We are tech industry veterans in software, hardware, and design who are pooling our skills to build the future we want to live in. We are solving real-world problems leveraging robotics, machine learning and computer vision, among other disciplines, with a mindful eye towards the end-to-end user experience. Our team is agile, diverse, and driven. We believe that the best way to solve complicated dynamic problems is collaboratively and respectfully.

title: Network IT Specialist
description:
As the Network IT Specialist at Rockbot, you'll serve as the technical backbone of Rockbot's escalation function — the person the team turns to when issues are complex, environments are nuanced, or recurring problems require durable, systemic solutions.

This is a deeply hands-on technical support role for someone who enjoys solving hard problems, improving systems, and making the entire support organization stronger over time.

You'll own Rockbot's most advanced support scenarios across networking, firewall configuration, hardware, player setup, connectivity, and enterprise environments while also serving as a key partner in evolving our AI-enabled support operations.

With the rollout of Zendesk AI Co-Pilot and related automation tooling, you'll help optimize how support operates at scale — improving triage, workflows, agent efficiency, self-service experiences, and data quality. Just as importantly, you'll help close the loop: identifying patterns, improving documentation, influencing product and operational improvements, and reducing future support volume through scalable fixes.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical troubleshooting skills with systems thinking, operational maturity, and strong customer instincts. You'll partner closely with the Director of Support and cross-functional teams in Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Sales, bringing a practitioner's perspective to configuring and optimizing the systems the team relies on.

What You'll Do

Tier 2 Escalation & Technical Resolution

  • Own escalated Tier 2 technical cases across networking, firewall configuration, hardware troubleshooting, player setup, connectivity failures, and platform-level issues
  • Diagnose root cause through systematic troubleshooting and isolation techniques in complex customer environments
  • Escalate issues to Product and Engineering with clear reproduction steps, technical context, impact assessment, and supporting data
  • Identify recurring hardware or platform failure patterns and proactively surface trends and recommendations
  • Maintain clear, proactive communication with customers and internal stakeholders on status, timelines, and resolution paths
  • Meet SLA commitments for escalated tickets while proactively identifying and escalating risks
  • Participate in on-call rotation and provide occasional after-hours, weekend, and holiday coverage for enterprise escalations

Enterprise & Strategic Account Support

  • Serve as a technical resource for enterprise and high-touch accounts with complex or customized environments
  • Support pilot and trial customers through technical validation, troubleshooting, and implementation guidance
  • Participate in customer calls, Slack channels, and cross-functional account reviews as needed
  • Partner with Customer Succes

ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Juul is the market leader in the e-Cigarette category with a tremendous amount of growth potential within our US Commercial organization. The Division Manager will report directly to the Region Field Sales Director in your market and lead a team of Territory Managers to maximize sales opportunities. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding.

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better.

About the role

This is a consultative B2B sales role focused on driving platform adoption across UK car dealerships and encouraging active daily auction participation.

You’ll manage a varied portfolio of dealer partners across the UK, ranging from onboarding brand-new businesses and winning back lapsed accounts, to optimizing performance for established, regular buyers. Rather than hard-selling from a rigid script, your goal is to ask great questions, understand each dealership’s unique business goals and position the value of Motorway to demonstrate a clear ROI. You will ultimately build high-value, collaborative and long-term relationships.

Whether you’re delivering a powerful first impression to a new account or embedding repeatable, profitable processes into an existing or lapsed partner's daily routine, you'll act as a trusted advisor to help them win. We don't expect you to know everything on day one, but we do look for solid sales foundations, curiosity, and a drive to learn. We’ll back you with structured coaching, dedicated mentorship, and all the tools you need to succeed.

Our mission is clear: to build a world where everything works at its best, ensuring every employee gets the support they need to thrive—both at work and beyond.

title: Technical Product Lead - AI Stockbroking
description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. title: Projektentwickler - Ostdeutschland (m/w/d)
description:
Q ENERGYs Ziel ist es, eine nachhaltige Welt mit grüner Energie zu ermöglichen. Unsere Unternehmenswerte - Verantwortung, Partnerschaft, Inklusive and "Changemaker" - sind die Grundlage für unser Handeln. Als Europas führender Anbieter von grünen Energielösungen sind wir ein vertrauenswürdiger Partner für das gesamte Spektrum der erneuerbaren Energien. Unser Ziel ist es, die Welt mit Solar-, Wind- und Hybridkraftwerken, innovativen Speicherlösungen und visionären grünen Wasserstoffprojekten neu zu definieren. 

Begleite uns auf dieser spannenden Reise, um unseren Planeten nachhaltig zu verändern.

Für unser Team suchen wir eine engagierte Projektmanager (m/w/d), die die erfolgreiche Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Wind-, PV- und BESS-Projekten von der ersten Standortidee bis zur Genehmigungsreife und Übergabe in die Realisierung verantwortet.

 

Ziel der Rolle ist es, wirtschaftlich attraktive, genehmigungsfähige und technisch umsetzbare Projekte zu identifizieren und gezielt voranzutreiben. Dabei übernimmst Du die ganzheitliche Steuerung der Projekte sowie die Koordination aller relevanten internen und externen Stakeholder und stellst die Einhaltung von Zeit-, Kosten-, Qualitäts- und Entwicklungszielen sicher.

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Projektakquise und Standortentwicklung: Identifikation, Bewertung und Sicherung geeigneter Standorte und Flächen für Wind-, PV- und BESS-Projekte einschließlich Machbarkeitsanalysen und Flächensicherung.
  • Projektentwicklung und Genehmigung: Entwicklung und Optimierung von Projekten, Steuerung der Genehmigungs- und Planungsverfahren sowie Koordination von Gutachtern, Planern, Behörden und weiteren Projektpartnern.
  • Technische und wirtschaftliche Entwicklung: Bewertung von Netzanschlussmöglichkeiten, Projektlayouts und Wirtschaftlichkeit sowie Steuerung von Kosten, Terminen, Risiken und Projektbudgets.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Data
description:
We are building the world's decision infrastructure: the strategic twin of every industrial organization for complex combinatorial problems. We unlocked what wasn't possible before: mapping reality with its levers and constraints into a computer, then running n-dimensional optimization on critical value-chain decisions. We help Europe stay strong and the German Mittelstand make good decisions between market shifts, orders, machines and people.

Founded by Dana (CEO) and Erik (CTO) from RWTH research, backed by a €2.8M round led by Vorwerk Ventures, with customers live on our optimization models.

We move fast. We care. No patience for problems left unsolved.

Your mission

Hi, I'm Erik, CTO of Circonomit. This ad is specific on purpose: you should be able to tell from it whether this is your job.

We build decision infrastructure for industrial companies: our customers model their production, with its capacities, costs and constraints, and we compute the answer to "what should we do?" before the decision is made.

Your mission: scale our data platform for multiple customers and domains. Customer data arrives in many formats from many sources, ERP exports included; it has to land in our system consistently, stay manageable at millions of records, and be fast to query when models and results are on-screen. The product is a data-heavy web app with a math-heavy backend (Python, TypeScript, Solid.js, Postgres, on Cloudflare): your center of gravity is data and infrastructure, but you touch the whole stack. We are looking for a system thinker who wants to shape the architecture.

We will not sugarcoat it: short deadlines, real workload, and a platform that grows while customers already run on it.

What you'll own

  • The data platform end to end: ingestion, storage, and the query paths that keep millions of records fast on screen. You design it, you build it, you run it in production.

title: Forward Deployed Scientist II
description:
Life at UiPath

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?

Your mission

This is one of the most exciting problems in applied AI right now: take the cutting edge of machine learning, optimisation, and agentic systems, and make it work inside real businesses — not in a lab, but on live customer problems where the answer has to hold up commercially.

As a Forward Deployed Scientist II, in our Supply Chain & Retail business, you’ll work directly with some of the world’s biggest retailers and manufacturers on hard, high-stakes problems: demand forecasting, price and promotion optimisation, and supply-chain decisioning. You’ll own the science end-to-end — from understanding a customer’s messy reality to shipping something that changes how they operate.

And you won’t just deliver. What you learn on the front line feeds directly back into the products we build, so you’re shaping the capability the whole business runs on — not just solving one problem at a time.

 

What you'll do at UiPath

  • Own customer engagements end-to-end — frame the problem, build the solution, and drive it to real commercial impact, working directly alongside customer teams.

title: Deployment Lead - ERP Solutions
description:
What We Do

Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.

Rillet is the AI-native ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 600 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG.

This huge market is ours to take. We’ve raised $200M+ from Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI.

Who We Are

Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.

The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.

Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan.

Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve and the impact our customers can create. Together, we combine the precision of accounting with the speed, creativity, and ambition

title: Solutions Architect
description:
About Plane

Plane's mission is to build the infrastructure the world's work runs on. Every organization runs on three things: the projects it's driving, the knowledge it keeps, and the requests it fields. Plane brings all three into one open, adaptable platform: simple enough for any team to adopt, dependable enough for organizations to build on. And we are building it for a future where humans and AI agents do that work together.

 

Plane began in public on GitHub at the end of 2022. Since then it has grown into a work management platform used by teams around the world: 55,000+ stars, 5,000+ forks, and a contributor community that reads our code and files our issues. Organizations run Plane as a managed Cloud service, on their own infrastructure, or inside fully isolated environments. Building in the open keeps us close to users and raises the standard for everything we ship.

 

Plane is the #1 work infrastructure in aerospace, defense, financial services, and other regulated industries: organizations whose requirements for control, auditability, and data residency rule most software out. When the strictest buyers pick a system of record, that choice means something. Adoption is growing fastest on Plane Cloud and in sovereign clouds, deployments that keep everything inside a country's own borders and rules.

 

Plane is backed by top investors and built across San Francisco, London, and Hyderabad. We work in tightly knit teams, stay close to users, and care about the visible product as much as the unglamorous details that make software dependable. People own problems end to end, and we add process only when it helps the work.

title: Marketing Manager (all genders)
description:
Lumiform is a specialized software for businesses with frontline teams to run inspections, audits and checklists at scale across distributed operations. Companies like EDEKA, AmRest (Starbucks, KFC, La Tagliatella), Nordsee, Hermes or even big Testing Inspection and Certification bodies rely on Lumiform to keep standards consistently high across hundreds of locations.

Our position in the market is clear: we're building authority in answer engine optimization (AEO) for inspection and audit software. We want to be the company that AI systems recommend when people ask "what is the best inspection software?" or "What is the best software for restaurants to nail HACCP documentation" That focus is where we win. It's also where your role is essential.

You will shape how Lumiform gets discovered in large language models and answer engines. You'll work directly with our founders to sharpen our positioning and prove it through content depth, benchmark reports, and answers that LLMs actually cite. You'll execute this strategy hands-on alongside two content writers (this is not a hands off, strategy only role).

This is a strategic role for an executor. You think systematically about positioning and content architecture, then get your hands dirty building it.

Tasks

Your core mandate sits on three priorities.

1. AEO Foundation and Technical Health

  • Conduct an extensive AEO and content audit. This includes technical site audits covering infrastructure, loading times, crawlability, indexation, canonicalization, and how our site structure serves answer engines.
  • Review all content for cannibalization and duplicate content, then systematically eliminate it. Answer engines penalize sites that repeat the same answer across multiple pages.
  • Define the must-win AEO phrases and questions. These are the high-intent searches and prompts where we need to be the answer LLMs recommend. Not every keyword

title: Customer Success Manager
description: Are you as comfortable working with commercial strategy as you are building trust with a customer? We are looking for a Customer Success Manager with a background in SaaS and an interest in cybersecurity.     Moxso helps organizations reduce human risk in cybersecurity - going beyond basic training to show real, measurable improvement in how resilient a company's employees are to cyber threats. We are a Copenhagen-based cybersecurity company serving Danish and international customers, and we are hiring a CSM to own a commercially significant book of business. title: Customer Success Manager
description: Dignio Oy on terveysteknologiayritys, joka tuo terveyspalvelut suoraan kotiin. Ratkaisumme yhdistää kaksi asiaa saman katon alle: Karie Duo -lääkeannostelijan, joka muistuttaa potilasta lääkkeenottoajasta ja annostelee oikean lääkkeen automaattisesti, sekä etähoivapalvelun, joka sisältää video- ja chat-yhteyden, lääketieteelliset mittaukset, kyselylomakkeet, terveyskoulutuksen ja omaispalvelun. Dignio Prevent -hallintajärjestelmä yhdistää laitteet samaan käyttöjärjestelmään, jonka avulla hoitohenkilöstö seuraa potilaiden vointia digitaalisesti ja saa hälytyksen esimerkiksi silloin, kun potilas unohtaa ottaa lääkkeensä tai mittaustulos poikkeaa raja-arvoista. Dignio on Pohjoismaiden ainoa toimija, jolla nämä kaksi ratkaisua toimivat samassa järjestelmässä.         Dignio on toiminut Norjassa jo 15 vuoden ajan, ja ratkaisujamme käyttää tänä päivänä yli 250 kuntaa sekä yli 50 000 potilasta. Riippumattomat tutkimukset osoittavat konkreettista vaikutusta: muun muassa 32 % vähemmän sairaalajaksoja ja 41-62 % pienemmät kustannukset potilasta kohden vuodessa. Vuonna 2026 toimintamalli laajeni menestyksekkäästi Ruotsiin, ja nyt on Suomen vuoro - Dignio Oy perustettiin tänä vuonna ja yritys voitti heti ensimmäisen merkittävän sopimuksensa.       Haemme uuteen tehtävään ammattitaitoista ja innostavaa      CUSTOMER SUCESS MANAGERIA      Toimit Dignion tärkeimpänä yhteyshenkilönä suomalaisille asiakkaillemme. Vastaat hyvinvointialueiden ja muiden terveydenhuollon toimijoiden asiakassalkusta sekä ratkaisun onnistuneesta käyttöönotosta - aina ensivaiheesta päivittäiseen toimintaan ja palvelujen laajentamiseen saakka.     Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä asiakasorganisaation sekä Dignion Norjan ja Ruotsin tiimien kanssa. Tehtäväsi painopisteinä ovat vahvojen asiakassuhteiden rakentaminen, ennakoiva konsultointi sekä syvällinen ymmärrys loppukäyttäjien ja terveydenhuollon ammattilaisten arjesta.  Suomen ensimmäisenä CSM:nä osallistut myös myyntiä tukeviin tehtäviin: käyt keskusteluja uushankinnan parissa, avustat tarjouskilpailuissa ja demonstroit ratkaisun tuomia käytännön hyötyjä.      Tehtäviisi kuuluvat mm:    Asiakasprosessien johtaminen ja edistäminen alusta loppuun  Tuet asiakkaita lääkeannostelijoiden ja digitaalisen etäseurannan käyttöönotossa  Rakennat pitkäaikaisia asiakassuhteita koulutuksen, seurannan ja strategisen neuvonnan keinoin  Työskentelet tiiviisti asiakkaiden parissa ohjaten, tukien, motivoiden ja haastaen  Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä tuotekehityksen ja teknisen tiimin kanssa kliinisen käytön osalta  Tunnistat ja edistät uusia mahdollisuuksia nykyisten asiakkuuksien sisällä  Havaitset ja hyödynnät uusia myyntimahdollisuuksia asiakasrajapinnassa  Edustat Digniota alan konferensseissa, messuilla ja muissa keskeisissä foorumeissa  Osallistut tarvittaessa tarjouskilpailuihin ja myyntitapaamisiin       Toivomme sinulta:    Innostusta kestävämmän terveydenhuollon rakentamisesta ja vahvaa uskoa missioomme  Soveltuvaa terveydenhuollon koulutu

title: Senior Account Manager
description: About AI Acquisition      AI Acquisition is a bootstrapped, founder-led business helping founders and operators scale with AI, combining a sales and delivery engine, one-to-one consultation, and our own SaaS platforms. We move fast, we build constantly, and we hold a high bar for the people who work directly with our clients.     We currently manage thousands of active clients across multiple products, with 250+ new clients onboarding every month. The Account Management function is the front line of that relationship.      The Role      You are the person between the client and the outcome. Not a relationship manager. Not a check-in scheduler. Not someone who forwards tickets and hopes for the best.     You own a portfolio of clients who are building real businesses with our support. Some are launching for the first time. Some are scaling. Some are stuck and frustrated. Your job is to diagnose where they actually are, figure out what's blocking their progress, manage their expectations when needed, and drive them toward commercial results, not just activity.     This means you need to understand marketing, sales, offer development, and fulfillment well enough to have real conversations about all of them. If a client's campaign is generating calls but nobody's closing, you need to be able to tell them why and what to do about it, not pass it to someone else.     Our clients purchase a fully built AI lead-generation business: brand, website, funnel, lead engine, and the systems that help turn leads into customers. You own the relationship around that delivery. You need to know what they bought, what was promised, where they are in the journey, and what needs to happen next, with specifics, not generalities.     You'll work directly with clients on Zoom, Slack, and through our internal systems. You'll run growth workshops, intro calls, and quick syncs. You'll manage escalations without panicking and celebrate wins without coasting. And when a client is about to walk, you'll be the person who finds the path to keep them or makes the honest call that they should go. Setting the bar in technical fabrics and functional design, we create transformational products and experiences that support people in moving, growing, connecting, and being well. We owe our success to our innovative product, emphasis on stores, commitment to our people, and the incredible connections we make in every community we're in. As a company, we focus on creating positive change to build a healthier, thriving future. In particular, that includes creating an equitable, inclusive and growth-focused environment for our people.   Job Summary   The Key Leader role is an essential part of the store leadership team, impacting salesfloor team members and guest (i.e., customer) experience every day. Key Leaders are responsible for leading by example and providing support to Educators, facilitating an outstanding guest experience in the store, and overseeing all operations of the retail floor. Key Leaders leverage key performance indicators and metrics to prioritize responsibilities while adapting to day-to-day business adjustments and challenges.   Key Responsibilities Of The Job    Leadership and People Management     Support ongoing learning and development of team members by providing direct feedback, coaching, mentoring, and career path guidance, and addressing performance concerns.  Provide team members recognition, gap assessment, and overall performance documentation to support and reinforce career and personal growth.  Develop, maintain, and disseminate product and general company knowledge through appropriate communication channels.     Guest (i.e., Customer) Experience     Provide salesfloor leadership to team members, including planning salesfloor coverage and making decisions to maintain efficiency and effectiveness of salesfloor operations.   Support team members (e.g., leading by example or coaching) with ensuring a great guest experience that values guests’ time, including assessing guest needs, providing technical product educations, and supporting in-store transactions and omnichannel programs (e.g., buy online/pickup in store, phone sales, and ship from store options).  Interact with and assess guests’ unique needs to provide customized, effective purchase and return solutions and support.   Provide technical product education by articulating the value and benefit of the product.   Resolve guest feedback and address guest concerns or escalations to make it “right” for guests.  Move dynamically on the floor to assess and fulfill the needs of the business, team, and guests.      Working With Others     Contribute to a respectful and inclusive team environment by welcoming and celebrating differences to ensure a supportive and engaging experience for all team members and guests.  Establish supportive and productive relationships with all team members.

title: Responsable rétention e-commerce complément alimentaire
description: Type de poste :  plein temps, long terme, remote (Europe). Présentiel possible à Genève, pas indispensable.   Disponibilité :  présence fiable sur les horaires européens   Rémunération :  selon votre expérience, vos résultats prouvés et la valeur que vous créez    Candidature :  uniquement via le formulaire en bas de page     Wellmark recrute un(e) responsable rétention & CRM pour prendre en charge la relation avec nos clients après leur premier achat, sur l'ensemble de nos marques.     Wellmark est un groupe suisse qui conçoit et vend des compléments alimentaires en direct depuis 2015. Plusieurs marques, une équipe réduite et entièrement à distance, et une culture de la donnée : on mesure tout, on teste beaucoup, on décide avec les chiffres.     On a construit une machine d'acquisition qui recrute des clients tous les jours sur différents canaux payants. On veut maintenant construire la meilleure rétention du DTC nutrition en Europe francophone, et on cherche la personne qui a une réelle expérience dans ce domaine.     Le cœur du poste, c'est comprendre une base de clients et les rendre fidèles : expérience après l'achat, communication, offres, abonnement, réactivation. On peut vous apprendre nos produits, nos outils et nos données. On ne peut pas vous apprendre le jugement, l'obsession du client et le sens commercial.  Vous pouvez venir de la rétention e-commerce, du CRM, du lifecycle marketing, de l'email en réponse directe, ou de la data avec une vraie obsession de la communication client. L'expérience en compléments alimentaires, beauté ou alimentaire est un réel plus.      Vous devez aussi être à la pointe de l'IA. On ne cherche pas quelqu'un qui colle un brief dans ChatGPT et nettoie le résultat. On cherche quelqu'un qui a construit un vrai système de travail assisté par IA, pour l'analyse, la segmentation et le contrôle qualité, qui sait où le jugement humain compte, et qui s'en sert pour produire plus et mieux sans jamais produire du générique.      Le résultat que vous possédez   Transformer une base d'acheteurs en une base de clients qui reviennent, et en répondre sur trois chiffres : le taux de rachat, la valeur d'un client sur douze mois, la part du chiffre d'affaires générée par la base. Pour ça, vous devez :   connaître la base mieux que quiconque dans l'entreprise, avec des segments et des cohortes qui servent à décider ;  construire une expérience après l'achat qui aide chaque client à réussir sa cure, à le constater, et à savoir à quoi il le doit ;  faire racheter : offres, abonnement, réassort, gamme, réactivation ;  produire une communication que les clients lisent, en français, dans un ton qui sonne juste pour chaque marque ;       Ce que vous ferez    Lire ce que disent les clients : avis, tickets support, sondages, verbatims, données de parcours. En tirer des segments et des décisions.  Concevoir et piloter le parcours après l'achat : onboarding, contenus de cure, supports physiques dans le colis, demandes d'avis...

title: Customer Success Manager
description: 🌍 La mission de Steeple    Chez Steeple, notre mission est simple :  améliorer l'accès à l'information de millions de collaborateurs, partout dans le monde.   Surtout celle de ceux qu’on oublie trop souvent : les collaborateurs terrain.   Comment ?   En aidant les entreprises à mieux communiquer avec tous leurs salariés, y compris ceux qui n’ont ni ordinateur, ni téléphone professionnel.   Grâce à quoi ?   Une solution phygitale : pas juste une appli mobile, pas un intranet de plus, mais une plateforme aussi accessible sur de grands écrans tactiles, installés au cœur des lieux de travail.   Le résultat ?   Fini les vieux panneaux d’affichage que personne ne lit.  Chaque collaborateur est enfin informé, considéré, engagé.    🚀 Une ambition assumée    Oui, notre mission est ambitieuse.  Mais on avance déjà bien :   👉 Plus de 1500 entreprises équipées  👉 Dans une vingtaine de pays  👉 350 000 collaborateurs touchés   Et on fait tout ça depuis  Rennes, sans levée de fonds, sans injonctions d’investisseurs, en autofinancement total .  Pas pour faire joli.  Parce qu’on croit à la liberté de construire à notre manière.   Créer un leader mondial des logiciels depuis Rennes et en autofinancement ?   Personne ne l’a fait.   Alors on le tente.   Mais ce genre de projet, avec cette ambition-là,  ça ne marche que si la culture d’entreprise est vraiment spéciale .  Et elle est loin d'être faite pour tout le monde.    🔥 La culture Steeple    Chez Steeple, on avance vite, on vise haut, et on le fait ensemble.  Mais ça ne peut fonctionner qu’avec les bonnes personnes à bord.  Ainsi tu es au bon endroit si :    Tu es prêt à mettre ton ambition au service du projet  Tu veux faire décoller ta carrière et tu es ok pour transpirer un peu au passage  Tu cherches de l’autonomie, des responsabilités, et tu assumes ce que ça implique  Tu veux que chaque journée soit différente, même si ça veut dire de nouvelles galères à gérer  Tu veux monter en compétences et grandir dans un environnement stimulant    Par contre, tu risques de ne pas t’épanouir si :    Tu considères que l’entreprise doit d’abord s’adapter à toi, pas l’inverse  Tu n’as pas envie de t’impliquer pleinement (ou du moins d’essayer)  Tu as besoin d’un cadre structuré et stable pour avancer sereinement  Tu recherches de la prévisibilité, un rythme régulier et sans surprise  Tu es plus à l’aise quand on te dit exactement quoi faire     En résumé   Steeple,  ce n’est pas un paquebot qui avance tranquille en ligne droite .  C’est un  voilier rapide dans une mer agitée .  Ça secoue, ça demande de l’engagement.  Et si ce n’est pas pour toi,  c’est totalement OK.  Vraiment. title: Customer Incident Manager
description: The role & its impact  When incidents happen, every second counts. You'll be the key orchestrator managing major and minor incidents from the customer's perspective—working across teams to find solutions fast and keep everyone informed. You'll balance immediate crisis response with strategic problem-solving, ensuring customers experience minimal disruption and have clarity on what's happening and why.  You'll own incident management end-to-end: from investigation and impact assessment through to post-incident reviews and recommendations that prevent problems from happening again. You'll build the systems and processes that help teams respond confidently and reduce incidents before they occur, making you instrumental in building customer trust.  The team & how they connect  The incident management team works at the heart of Xero's customer operations, coordinating across engineering, product, support, and leadership to respond to issues that affect our customers. They're problem-solvers who thrive in fast-paced environments, bringing rigour and human empathy to every incident response. The team collaborates across geographic regions and departments, treating every issue as an opportunity to strengthen Xero's resilience.  The team is currently working on / Initially, the role may focus on    Building and refining incident management processes and incident registers to prevent issues before they occur  Managing customer-facing communications during incidents to keep stakeholders informed and reassured  Coordinating cross-functional teams to implement both short-term fixes and long-term solutions  Post-incident reviews and recommendations that help reduce recurrence    Where and how you can work  This role has a hybrid working arrangement of 3 days working from our offices and 2 days working from home.  Here are some of the things we are looking for    You'll bring strong stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to make informed decisions and lead teams through high-pressure situations toward resolution.  You'll thrive on building relationships and collaborating effectively—your ability to influence across all levels and challenge assumptions respectfully makes you a natural leader in complex situations.  You'll demonstrate a genuine customer service mentality, ensuring every decision prioritises minimising customer impact and keeping them informed with clarity.  You'll bring proven experience managing major incidents or complex issues, alongside a track record of leading projects to successful delivery outcomes.  You'll Go Together by coordinating specialist teams across regions and bringing the right people to the table to solve problems—comfortable working autonomously but knowing when to collaborate.  You'll Go Fast by ship ideas, test solutions, and improve them—taking initiative and pushing forward in fast-paced, high-profile environments without waiting for perfect clarity.     Apply even if your experience isn't

title: Senior Change Manager
description: Help make Auckland and Aucklanders more resilient to natural hazards    Flexible working and option to purchase an extra week's leave    Salary will be $115,000 to $130,000 plus 3.5% KiwiSaver contribution        He angitūtanga: The opportunity    Auckland Council is establishing a Natural Hazards and Loss Modelling programme team to better manage the natural hazards risks to its $77 billion asset base, driven by climate change and population growth/intensification.  Because of our scale we have a unique opportunity to build our in-house capability to model these hazards and their consequences, to develop mitigation strategies to make Auckland more resilient and to reduce costs for our residents.  We are recruiting specialists and subject matter experts to be part of this team, from science, asset management, programme management and digital engineering backgrounds. Their work will integrate hazard science, exposure, vulnerability modelling, financial risk analysis and spatial data expertise into a single in-house function, streamlining Auckland Council’s approach to natural hazard risk management. This will enhance council’s ability to make consistent, evidence-based decisions about resilience, public safety, land use and insurance.  This programme team will be split across our existing Asset Management Centre of Excellence (who work to improve asset management practices across the whole Auckland Council Group), and our Natural Hazards Team (who coordinate our understanding and response to natural hazards across the organisation).  We are looking for a change manager who will be based in the Asset Management Centre of Excellence, and who will collaborate with the Natural Hazards team and others across the organisation, to develop and implement change strategies to embed system change relating to asset management system improvements, natural hazard understanding, and resilience across the organisation. You will work closely with key stakeholders at all levels to identify impacts, manage resistance, and deliver on plans to ensure a smooth transition to new ways of working.  You could expect to work on:     planning and delivering effective change spanning the full programme and project lifecycle    supporting other departments in implementing changes from the work    developing and delivering training programmes    assessing organisational readiness and identifying potential risks and resistance to change    providing expert advice to the leadership team on change and communication      You will be based in our office in the Auckland City Centre and we offer some flexibility to work from home or at other council offices. title: Customer Success Manager
description: About ISpeedToLead   iSpeedToLead is a two-sided real estate lead marketplace operating across the United States. Sellers of motivated-seller leads list on one side, and real estate investors buy on the other. We are a bootstrapped, profitable product company with an engineering and analytics team that ships fast and makes decisions from data rather than opinion.   About The Role   This is the first dedicated Customer Success hire at iSpeedToLead. Today, buyers are supported reactively: tickets get answered, credits get issued, and nobody owns what happens to an account between its first purchase and its last one.  You will own the post-purchase relationship with our buyers. That means onboarding them properly, keeping high-value accounts healthy, and turning churn from something we observe into something we manage. You will build the function itself (playbooks, health scoring, reporting) rather than inherit it.  One thing worth stating openly before you apply: the workload is around 50 hours a week for the first 6 to 9 months while the function is being built. We would rather you decline now than discover it in month two.   Key Responsibilities    Onboarding and activation     Own the onboarding of new buyers end to end, from first purchase to first repeat purchase.   Run onboarding calls and follow-ups, making sure every new buyer understands how to filter, buy, and work leads effectively.   Design and maintain the onboarding sequence (content, timing, channel) and improve it based on what actually converts.      Account health and retention     Manage a book of high-value accounts with regular check-ins, usage reviews, and proactive outreach.   Build and maintain a health-scoring model that flags at-risk accounts before they churn, not after.   Run save conversations on at-risk accounts and document what worked, by reason code.      Escalations and problem-solving     Act as the escalation point for buyer complaints, including lead quality disputes, refund requests, and billing or balance issues.   Coordinate with support, sales, and engineering to resolve issues, and follow through until the customer confirms resolution.   Operate within agreed refund and credit authority limits, and defend those decisions with data.      Voice of the customer     Collect, categorise, and quantify churn and refund reasons, turning anecdotes into a ranked list.   Deliver a weekly written report to product and leadership on retention performance and the top issues driving cancellations.   Advocate for the product changes that would remove recurring causes of churn.      Process and reporting     Build the Customer Success playbooks from scratch: onboarding, save, win-back, and escalation.   Maintain accurate account records and interaction history in our systems.   Report on retention metrics weekly, and own the definitions behind them.      Collaboration     Work daily with sales on the handoff of new buyers, and with support on ticket patterns.   Partner w

Tehtävän palkkahaitari on 2500-3200€/kk. Palkkaus määräytyy tehtävään valitun henkilön osaamisen ja kokemuksen perusteella.  Raportoit Service Desk Operations-tiiminvetäjälle. M365, Windows 11, Intune ja Active Directory)  Hyvät asiakaspalvelutaidot  Hyvät paineensietokyvyt määrällisten, ajallisten ja laadullisten odotusten suhteen  Valmiudet puhelimitse tehtävään asiakaspalveluun  Suomen kielen kirjallisen ja suullisen osaamisen lisäksi myös englannin kielen osaamista    Arvostamme aiempaa kokemusta Service Desk- tai IT-tukitehtävistä sekä innokasta, oma-aloitteista ja ratkaisukeskeistä työotetta. title: Serviceleder til Ventilations afdelingen i Aalborg
description: Vil du være med til at hjælpe vores kunder med at reducere energiforbruget og skabe smartere tekniske løsninger?    Har du en el-teknisk baggrund, erfaring fra ventilation og lyst til at blive en del af et stærkt team med høj faglighed og godt sammenhold?   Hos Bravida søger vi en serviceleder til vores ventilationsafdeling i Aalborg med fokus på energioptimering. Du bliver en del af en velfungerende afdeling med stærke relationer til vores kunder og et tæt samarbejde med både anlægs- og montageafdelingen.  Som serviceleder får du en central rolle i at rådgive kunder om energioptimerende løsninger, udvikle eksisterende kunderelationer og sikre den daglige koordinering af serviceopgaver. Du bliver en del af et mindre team, hvor samarbejde, sparring og en uformel omgangstone er en naturlig del af hverdagen.  Du får din daglige base i vores storrumskontor, hvor du bliver omgivet af kolleger, som har været en del af Bravida i mange år. Vi sætter stor pris på fællesskabet, den gode tone og hjælper hinanden, når der er behov for det.  I rollen arbejder du tæt sammen med ca. 15 dygtige medarbejdere i marken samt vores anlægs- og montageafdeling for at sikre de bedste løsninger for kunderne.   Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet inkludere     Rådgivning af kunder om energioptimering og energieffektive ventilationsløsninger  Planlægning, koordinering og opfølgning på serviceopgaver  Opbygning og vedligeholdelse af stærke kunderelationer  Tæt samarbejde med teknikere, montører og projektorganisationen  Sparring med kunder om forbedringsforslag og optimeringsmuligheder  Sikring af høj kvalitet, god kundeservice og effektiv opgavestyring     Hvem er du?   Vi leder efter dig, som trives i krydsfeltet mellem teknik, kunder og koordinering. Du motiveres af at skabe værdi for kunderne og er dygtig til at bygge tillidsfulde relationer, som holder over tid.  Vi forestiller os, at du har:    En el-teknisk baggrund  Erfaring fra ventilationsbranchen  Erfaring som ventilations- eller servicetekniker er en fordel  Forståelse for energioptimering og tekniske installationer  Evnen til at skabe og fastholde gode kunderelationer  Kendskab til køleteknik er en fordel, men ikke et krav     Hos os får du   Du bliver en del af en afdeling med stærke faglige kompetencer og et tæt samarbejde på tværs af fagområder. Vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes gennem gode relationer, høj faglighed og et stærkt fællesskab.  Hos Bravida får du:    Et spændende ansvarsområde med fokus på den grønne omstilling og energioptimering  Et lille og sammentømret team med korte beslutningsveje  Tæt samarbejde med vores anlægs- og montageafdeling  Dygtige kolleger og cirka 15 medarbejdere i marken  En arbejdsplads med stærkt sammenhold og en uformel omgangstone  Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling    Vi arbejder som ét Bravida på tværs af fag og regioner. Du får et stærkt professionelt netværk, der altid står klar med sparring. Hos os er trivsel, sikkerhed og fællesskab afgør

title: Head of Customer Growth
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Customer Growth based in Switzerland.   As Head of Customer Growth, you will build and lead a comprehensive operating system designed to help customers become stronger, more successful businesses. Drive meaningful product adoption: Work with Product and Product Marketing to ensure customers adopt capabilities that genuinely improve their outcomes rather than simply increasing feature usage. title: Head of Markets & Customers
description: Unser Mandant ist ein etablierter und erfolgreicher Schweizer Qualitätsanbieter im Bereich anspruchsvoller Sicherheits- und Servicedienstleistungen. Als Teil einer finanzstarken, technologisch zukunftsorientierten Unternehmensgruppe betreut die Organisation täglich ein breites Portfolio aus B2B-Kunden, institutionellen Partnern sowie Privatkunden. Im Zuge des nachhaltigen Wachstums und der strategischen Weiterentwicklung wird eine visionäre, führungsstarke Persönlichkeit gesucht.    Abteilungskompetenz: Strategische und operative Führung sowie Weiterentwicklung des Bereichs «Markt und Kunden» mit rund 20 Mitarbeitenden.  Marktgestaltung: Kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der Marktbearbeitung, der Kundenstrategie und des Dienstleistungsangebots zur Erschliessung neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten.  Performance-Management: Sicherstellung einer effizienten Marktbearbeitung und eines professionellen Kundenmanagements im Tagesgeschäft sowie zielgerichtete Umsetzung von Budget- und Jahreszielen.  Schnittstellenfunktion: Steuerung der Zusammenarbeit mit Vertriebspartnern, Grosskunden sowie internen Organisationseinheiten zur Gewährleistung einer hohen Daten- und Servicequalität.  Teamkultur: Führung, Coaching und Entwicklung des Teams sowie aktive Förderung einer leistungsorientierten und offenen Unternehmenskultur.  Innovation: Kontinuierliche Optimierung von Prozessen, Kennzahlen und Qualitätsstandards unter Vorantrieb von Digitalisierungsprojekten.  Repräsentation: Agieren als kompetente/-r Sparringpartner/-in der Geschäftsleitung sowie Repräsentation des Unternehmens gegenüber Partnern und im Markt.

title: Senior Account Manager
description: About AI Acquisition      AI Acquisition is a bootstrapped, founder-led business helping founders and operators scale with AI, combining a sales and delivery engine, one-to-one consultation, and our own SaaS platforms. We move fast, we build constantly, and we hold a high bar for the people who work directly with our clients.     We currently manage thousands of active clients across multiple products, with 250+ new clients onboarding every month. The Account Management function is the front line of that relationship.      The Role      You are the person between the client and the outcome. Not a relationship manager. Not a check-in scheduler. Not someone who forwards tickets and hopes for the best.     You own a portfolio of clients who are building real businesses with our support. Some are launching for the first time. Some are scaling. Some are stuck and frustrated. Your job is to diagnose where they actually are, figure out what's blocking their progress, manage their expectations when needed, and drive them toward commercial results, not just activity.     This means you need to understand marketing, sales, offer development, and fulfillment well enough to have real conversations about all of them. If a client's campaign is generating calls but nobody's closing, you need to be able to tell them why and what to do about it, not pass it to someone else.     Our clients purchase a fully built AI lead-generation business: brand, website, funnel, lead engine, and the systems that help turn leads into customers. You own the relationship around that delivery. You need to know what they bought, what was promised, where they are in the journey, and what needs to happen next, with specifics, not generalities.     You'll work directly with clients on Zoom, Slack, and through our internal systems. You'll run growth workshops, intro calls, and quick syncs. You'll manage escalations without panicking and celebrate wins without coasting. And when a client is about to walk, you'll be the person who finds the path to keep them or makes the honest call that they should go. title: Client Consultant
description: Är du vår nya Client Consultant?       Vill du bli vår nya kollega och hjälpa oss ge våra kunder en kundupplevelse i världsklass? Är du en sann lagspelare som ser teamets framgång som din egen? Har du erfarenhet av inkassobranschen och gillar att arbeta med varierade uppgifter och många kontaktytor? Då är det dig vi söker!    Vi söker nu förstärkning till vårt team inom SME B2B/B2C. Hos oss blir du en del av ett företag och team som befinner sig i en spännande fas där ständig utveckling är centralt.        Som ett marknadsledande kredithanteringsföretag har Intrum en bred kompetens inom inkassotjänster och vi gör affärer i 20 länder i Europa. Vi har mer än 10 000 erfarna medarbetare i vår grupp.    Vår verksamhet handlar om att hjälpa andra. Hjälpa skuldsatta individer att ta sig ur svåra situationer. Hjälpa företag att få betalt så att de kan växa, anställa och blomstra. Vilket i sin tur är positivt för hela ekonomin. Du blir en väsentlig del av denna krets hos oss, vilket ger ditt jobb på Intrum en djupare mening. Oavsett din roll eller titel.      Att ligga i framkant är allas jobb    Som marknadsledare är det upp till oss att ligga i framkant. Att forma branschen. Att sätta nya standarder. Och vart än i världen din Intrum-karriärväg tar dig, vilken roll du än spelar, kommer du att bidra till tillväxt, innovation och inverkan som gör verklig skillnad.      Rollen   Som Client Consultant arbetar du proaktivt och självständigt som ansvarig för din leverans till ett antal egna små- och medelstora kunder samtidigt som du är en del utav ett team. Du är kundens kontaktperson i operativa frågor och har en central roll i kundsamarbetet. Du fångar upp frågor och problem från dina kunder som du löser självständigt eller i samråd med interna avdelningar.   Plats för denna position: Göteborg   Hybridarbete. Vi ser att hybridarbete, där vi som medarbetare kan arbeta antingen hemifrån eller från kontoret, skapar möjligheter att prestera och arbeta effektivt i virtuella och reella miljöer.   Du kommer att rapportera till  Team Manager Mandana Jafari      Dina arbetsuppgifter    Ansvara för kundkontakten i leveransen av våra inkassotjänster.  Besvara frågor, vara rådgivande och analysera för att förbättra kundens och Intrums rutiner och processer.  Säkerställa hög kvalitet och effektivitet i våra leveranser till kund  Kommunicera med kunder via telefon, mejl och personliga möten.  Hålla kundutbildningar i inkassoprocessen och vår kundportal.  Koordinera rutiner kring kundens filkommunikation och kvalitetssäkra leveransen.  Bidra med analys- och åtgärdsförslag kopplat till nyckeltal per kund i nära dialog med ansvarig Account Manager.  Vid behov stötta med handläggning av inkassoärenden.  Bidra till trygg och smidig Onboarding av nya kunder.      Du arbetar nära dina kollegor för att skapa en positiv upplevelse för våra kunder och deras kunder. Du utmanar befintliga rutiner och arbetssätt för att skapa effektivare processer och ökad lönsamhet.      Dina kv

title: Solutions Consultant
description: Making Construction Better   In this role, you will be responsible for driving the growth and development of our service solutions, helping customers improve their productivity and efficiency. You will lead the rollout and implementation of key initiatives like Fleet Premium, ensuring seamless adoption for both customers and internal teams. Working closely with our Regional Marketing Team and global stakeholders, you will bring international best practices to life in the local market. A key part of your responsibility will be to establish and lead the Life Cycle Management (LCM) setup, ensuring the long-term success of our solution business and managing a dedicated LCM team. Additionally, you will play a crucial role in supporting other markets across the region to scale their service offerings and maximize customer value.   What You'll Do   As Solution Consultant, you work on the launch of our new asset management solution Hilti ON!Track. Together with our sales regions in Germany and market organisations in Central Europe, you ensure sustainable success of our new asset management solution with your strong customer and service orientation. You train the salesforce, support the sales process of ON!Track and Fleet Management (tool park management solution) and implement the solutions at the customers’ side. title: Manager
description: Manager - Brands & Commercial   Reports to: Head of D2C      About the Role   We are looking for a sharp, commercially minded operator who can understand what is happening in the business, form a clear point of view, and act quickly.  You will work closely with the Head of D2C and act as the commercial point of truth across brands, the market and StarZen's omnichannel business.   This is not a reporting role. It is not a pure buying role. It is not a strategy role.   You are expected to understand the numbers, make the commercial call, and drive action.      What You Will Own    1. Brand Intelligence    What are our brands telling us?   You will work closely with brands and distributors and maintain a clear view of:   upcoming launches and product roadmaps  supply and allocations  commercial terms and incentives  vendor funding  channel priorities  opportunities and risks   You should know what is coming early enough for StarZen to act on it.   2. Market Intelligence    What is the market telling us?   You will continuously understand:   competitor pricing  assortment  availability  promotions  new launches  changing customer demand  category and market movements   We are not looking for someone who simply sends competitor screenshots.   We want someone who can say: "This matters. This doesn't. Here is what we should do."    3. Commercial Truth    What are our own numbers telling us?   You will understand the business deeply, including at SKU level. You will regularly work across:   sales  gross margin  stock  ageing  sell-through  availability  pricing  promotions  brand and category performance  retail and e-commerce performance   When different teams have different explanations for what is happening, you should be able to establish the commercial truth.   4. Commercial Action    What are we doing about it?   Analysis must result in action. Depending on the situation, that could mean:   buying more stock  stopping or reducing buys  changing prices  negotiating with a vendor  securing additional allocation  moving stock between channels  changing the assortment  starting or stopping a promotion  securing vendor funding  clearing ageing inventory  changing the commercial plan   Buying is an important part of the role. You will be expected to make sound decisions on what to buy, how much to buy and why.  You will have a Commercial Operations Executive supporting you with POs, master data, trackers and recurring administrative work. Your time should be spent on commercial judgement, decisions, negotiation and execution.   What this looks like in practice:    "Stop the promotion. We're giving away four points of margin and it isn't creating incremental volume. The competitor moved price on two hero SKUs, not the category. We match those two, hold everything else, and move the vendor funding into the flagship line." And by the same afternoon, the vendor conversation has happened, pricing is aligned, and execution is already moving.       Who

Na rozdíl od práce pro jednu firmu, kde se pohybujete v jednom produktu a na jednom trhu, vás čeká nesrovnatelně pestřejší svět.  Zhruba polovinu času tak strávíte přímo s firmami, na schůzkách s nimi, na konzultacích a řešením konkrétních potřeb. Druhou polovinu vyplní příprava, analýza, interní práce a čas na akcích a networkingu, včetně jejich facilitace. Tím vším se budete podílet na rozvoji celého inovačního ekosystému v Jihomoravském kraji.  Mám zájem o pozici   Co zvládnete za první 3 měsíce?     Budete znát nabídku produktů JIC a umět je nabídnout.  Absolvujete schůzku s 5 firmami ze svého portfolia.  U těchto firem uděláte analýzu potřeb a domluvíte konkrétní kroky s termíny.  Zajistíte první konkrétní dodávku produktu JIC pro firmu ze svého portfolia.  Budete pracovat s CRM a vést si v něm zápisy.  Budete vědět, na koho se uvnitř JIC s čím obrátit.    Jaké budou vaše cíle pro první rok?    Vaše portfolio bude obsahovat cca 30 klíčových firem, se kterými budete budovat pevný vztah.  U každé z těchto firem připravíte plán rozvoje s termíny na základě analýzy potřeb.  Firmám ze svého portfolia dodáte konkrétní produkty JIC podle plánu.  Budete znát nabídku expertů JIC a umět na ně firmy ze svého portfolia propojit.  Vaše data v CRM budou spolehlivá.  Aktivně budete vyhledávat a oslovovat nové firmy s potenciálem stát se klientem JIC a rozšíříte tak své portfolio.     Koho Hledáme   Potřebujeme člověka se zkušeností s budováním dlouhodobých vztahů na úrovni majitelů a top managementu, který má vlastní síť kontaktů a umí ji použít ve prospěch firem ve svém portfoliu. Oceníme zkušenost z klíčové role ve firmě, která reálně škálovala, z odvětví, na která se zaměřujeme, případně má za sebou exit, fundraising nebo mezinárodní expanzi. Díky tomu rozumí tomu, jak se firma financuje a jak se řídí růst, a dokáže vyhodnotit potenciál firmy i obhájit svoje doporučení. Velkou výhodou je orientace ve startupovém ekosystému.  Koho Monika do svého týmu hledá?   „Hledám člověka s obchodním duchem, který bude mít na starosti portfolio firem od prvních opakovaných tržeb až po ty globálně úspěšné. Někoho, kdo se nebojí se vyrazit do terénu a umí mluvit jazykem founderů. Umí si získat jejich důvěru, ptát se, naslouchat a rozpoznat, kde umí JIC firmu reálně podpořit. Dokáže jejich potřeby adresovat konkrétní službou ve správný čas. Chci parťáka pro foundera, který se v různorod

We are a bootstrapped, profitable product company with an engineering and analytics team that ships fast and makes decisions from data rather than opinion.   About The Role   This is the first dedicated Customer Success hire at iSpeedToLead. Today, buyers are supported reactively: tickets get answered, credits get issued, and nobody owns what happens to an account between its first purchase and its last one.  You will own the post-purchase relationship with our buyers. That means onboarding them properly, keeping high-value accounts healthy, and turning churn from something we observe into something we manage. You will build the function itself (playbooks, health scoring, reporting) rather than inherit it.  One thing worth stating openly before you apply: the workload is around 50 hours a week for the first 6 to 9 months while the function is being built. We would rather you decline now than discover it in month two.   Key Responsibilities    Onboarding and activation     Own the onboarding of new buyers end to end, from first purchase to first repeat purchase.   Run onboarding calls and follow-ups, making sure every new buyer understands how to filter, buy, and work leads effectively.   Design and maintain the onboarding sequence (content, timing, channel) and improve it based on what actually converts.      Account health and retention     Manage a book of high-value accounts with regular check-ins, usage reviews, and proactive outreach.   Build and maintain a health-scoring model that flags at-risk accounts before they churn, not after.   Run save conversations on at-risk accounts and document what worked, by reason code.      Escalations and problem-solving     Act as the escalation point for buyer complaints, including lead quality disputes, refund requests, and billing or balance issues.   Coordinate with support, sales, and engineering to resolve issues, and follow through until the customer confirms resolution.   Operate within agreed refund and credit authority limits, and defend those decisions with data.      Voice of the customer     Collect, categorise, and quantify churn and refund reasons, turning anecdotes into a ranked list.   Deliver a weekly written report to product and leadership on retention performance and the top issues driving cancellations.   Advocate for the product changes that would remove recurring causes of churn.      Process and reporting     Build the Customer Success playbooks from scratch: onboarding, save, win-back, and escalation.   Maintain accurate account records and interaction history in our systems.   Report on retention metrics weekly, and own the definitions behind them.      Collaboration     Work daily with sales on the handoff of new buyers, and with support on ticket patterns.   Partner w

title: Customer Success Manager
description: Customer Success Manager       Over MyPup   MyPup, My Pick Up Point, biedt een duurzame oplossing voor pakketbezorging. Door pakketten van alle bezorgdiensten te bundelen aan de rand van steden, voorkomen we dat elke vervoerder afzonderlijk de stad in rijdt. Vervolgens bezorgen wij de pakketten emissievrij bij onze pakketkluizen. Onze missie is om een blijvende verandering te realiseren in de last-mile logistiek en zo bij te dragen aan minder verkeersbewegingen, minder uitstoot en leefbare steden.      Jouw rol   Als Customer Success Manager ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het succes van onze klanten. Je bent het belangrijkste aanspreekpunt na de installatie van een Pick Up Point en zorgt ervoor dat klanten en gebruikers optimaal gebruikmaken van onze dienstverlening. Je bouwt duurzame relaties op, analyseert prestaties, signaleert verbeterkansen en draagt direct bij aan klanttevredenheid, contractverlengingen en groei.      Jouw verantwoordelijkheden   • Beheren van een eigen klantenportfolio.  • Fungeren als strategische sparringpartner voor klanten.  • Monitoren en analyseren van prestaties van Pick Up Points.  • Ontwikkelen en uitvoeren van activatiecampagnes.  • Opstellen en presenteren van rapportages en klantreviews.  • Signaleren van trends, kansen en verbeterpunten.  • Identificeren van upsell- en cross-sellmogelijkheden.  • Verantwoordelijk voor contractverlengingen en klantbehoud.  • Samenwerken met Marketing, Sales en Operations.  • Verzamelen van klantfeedback en bijdragen aan verbeterprojecten.      Een rol die met je meegroeit   Je begint met het leren kennen van het bedrijf. Vanaf dag één krijg je de verantwoordelijkheid over een eigen klantenportefeuille en ben je verantwoordelijk voor klanttevredenheid, activatie, betrokkenheid en contractverlengingen. Je beheert strategische accounts en draagt actief bij aan commerciële kansen en groeimogelijkheden.      Wat succes betekent in deze rol   • Sterke klantrelaties opgebouwd.  • Gebruikersbetrokkenheid verhoogd.  • Bijgedragen aan contractverlengingen.  • Nieuwe commerciële kansen geïdentificeerd.  • Een vertrouwde adviseur geworden voor klanten en collega’s.      Jij bent   • Klantgericht én commercieel ingesteld.  • Sterke communicator in Nederlands en Engels.  • Analytisch en comfortabel met rapportages.  • Proactief, ondernemend en oplossingsgericht.  • Gestructureerd en stressbestendig.  • Een teamspeler met energie en eigenaarschap.      Wij Bieden   • Een transparant en eerlijk salaris tussen de €2478 en €5399 bruto per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur) gebaseerd op ons functiehuis.  • Een impactvolle rol binnen een duurzame scale-up.  • Veel vrijheid, verantwoordelijkheid en ruimte voor initiatief.  • Een jong en enthousiast team.  • Volop mogelijkheden om mee te groeien met de organisatie.     Herken jij jezelf in deze vacature? Stuur dan een e-mail naar werken@mypup.nl!     MyPup wil bijdragen aan een betere samenleving door middel van diversiteit, gelijkheid en inclusiviteit.

title: Senior Customer Service Manager (Outreach and Frontline Services)
description: Your role within Housing and Homelessness Services will support the department to provide immediate, coordinated multi-agency assistance to individuals and families experiencing or at risk of homelessness to ensure they receive the support and services needed.  The work you will do helps someone every day, and that means the world to us.  As Senior Customer Service Manager, you will ensure efficient and effective service delivery that is reflective of customer need and aligned to outcomes for the individual and the organisation.   What You Will Be Doing     Provide leadership, guidance and support to the Manager and all staff through the effective coordination of a range of activities such as workload and workforce management and planning.  Provide outreach and assistance to customers experiencing homelessness, including individuals sleeping rough, sleeping in vehicles, tents or makeshift structures, to access safe, secure and appropriate housing.  Appropriately and sensitively respond to customers experiencing homelessness to understand their specific housing and support needs.  Work collaboratively with Housing Service Centres (HSC's), Specialist Homelessness Services, service providers and support agencies to plan and deliver housing assistance.  Create a team culture which thrives on communication, collaboration, continuous improvement, positivity, safety, learning and capability building.  Be an active and positive member of the Critical Response leadership team.  Ensure staff are supported to achieve excellence in their performance at work through promoting and supporting a high-performance culture that maximises potential.  Apply HR management policies and principles by coordinating and monitoring the delivery of service consistent with financial, HR and administrative delegations and responsibilities.  Develop and apply a high level of awareness and understanding of protocols and issues impacting on Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples to facilitate improved service delivery and customer outcomes and communicating effectively and sensitively with people from different cultural backgrounds.  Lead and ensure you establish and maintain a workplace safety culture by ensuring that all policies and practices concerning Workplace Health and Safety are applied and a part of day-to-day operations.      Mandatory Requirement      Class C driver's license  Travel will be required for this role including overnight travel.      Applications to remain current for 12 months.    Occupational group  Community Care
