title: Director of Ad Sales - West
description:
Our mission at Duolingo is to develop the best education in the world and make it universally available. It’s a big mission, and that’s where you come in!

At Duolingo, you’ll join a team that cares about educating our users, experimenting with big ideas, making fact-based decisions, and finding innovative solutions to complex problems. You’ll have limitless learning opportunities and daily collaborations with world-class minds — while doing work that’s both meaningful and fun.

Join our life-changing mission to develop education for our half a billion (and growing!) learners around the world.

Read our blog to learn more.

About the role...

Join us to build Duolingo Ads, Duolingo’s direct ad business. Most learners use our free, ad‑supported app—so great ads are core to our mission. We’re hiring a Head of West Coast Sales to open and scale our West Coast region. You will set regional strategy, build and lead a high‑performing team, and own revenue outcomes across priority verticals and agency holding companies. As a player/coach, you’ll cultivate senior‑level relationships, shape pricing and packaging with leadership, and close high‑impact deals that both delight learners and drive revenue while leading a team of sellers. This is a high‑ownership, early‑stage opportunity to help define how ads show up for hundreds of millions of learners while building a repeatable, data‑driven go‑to‑market.

You will...

  • Own West Coast revenue targets and forecasting; build a healthy, predictable pipeline across named accounts and agency groups, and deliver against quarterly goals.
  • Develop and execute the regional go‑to‑market strategy, including territory design, vertical focus, pricing/packaging inputs, and coverage plans as we scale.
  • Hire, coach, and lead a small team of sellers over time; establish operating rhythms, deal reviews, and CRM hygiene standards that improve forecast accuracy and execution.
  • Build and deepen senior relationships at brands and agencies; open new logos and expand strategic accounts with clear commercial narratives that map Duolingo’s unique strengths (design, IP, native formats) to client objectives.
  • Lead complex deals end‑to‑end—from prospecting and positioning through negotiation, close, renewal, and expansion—partnering tightly with Account Management and Ad Ops for flawless delivery.
  • Share actionable market feedback with sales and product leadership to inform pricing, packaging, measurement, and ad experiences while protecting the learner experience.
  • Operate with speed and rigor in a startup‑like environment, building repeatable sales motions, outreach cadences, and team practices that scale from 0→1 and 1→N.

Project Bay ist der erste CoWorking-Living Space mit direktem Meerzugang und neuer Hotspot für Innovation im Norden. Die Themen „Digitalisierung, Künstliche Intelligenz und neue Mobilitätslösungen“ werden hierbei mit regionaler Community, Work-Life-Balance und Natur pur verbunden.  

Wir bieten unseren Kunden Büro- und CoWorking-Flächen, Break-Out-Optionen sowie Fortbildungen, Freizeitangebote und Übernachtungen direkt am Meer auf Rügen. Des Weiteren verfügen
wir über einen Accelerator "Founders Bay",
um junge Startups mit Fokus auf Nachhaltigkeit zu unterstützen.  

Ab sofort sind wir auch im Aufbau des ersten MakerSpaces auf der Insel Rügen. Neben digitalen Lösungen ist es notwendig auch einen Ort für Hardware-Lösungen zu schaffen. Mit den Synergien
unseres neuen Accelerators für nachhaltige Startups und den Kooperationen zu den Hochschulen, Kammern usw., möchten wir mit dem MakerSpace einen Ort für Handwerk, Selbstständige, Kreative und Startups schaffen.  

Neben diesen Themen beschäftigen wir uns rundum neue Projekte im Bereich: Expansion mit neuen Spaces, IT Lösungen, CarSharing, Tinyhäuser und noch vieles mehr.

Aufgaben

  • Du unterstützt beim Aufbau und der Entwicklung neuer Geschäftsbereiche und verfolgst selbstständig die Erreichung der Ziele.  
  • Du unterstützt die Geschäftsleitung in allen organisatorischen und administrativen Aufgaben.  
  • Du unterstützt die Geschäftsführung bei allen Unterfirmen/neuen Projekten (IT-Firma, CarSharing, Tinyhouses, neue Spaces) 
  • Du erstellst Entscheidungsvorlagen sowie Präsentationen und Grafiken inkl. Analysen. 
  • Du fungierst als Kommunikationsschnittstelle zwischen der Geschäftsleitung und externen Geschäftspartnern sowie Mitarbeitern in deutscher und englischer Sprache.  
  • Du übernimmst die Vor- und Nachbereitung von Meetings und Telefonkonferenzen inkl. Protokollführung. 
  • Du übernimmst Terminkoordination und -kontrolle,

Partner with CX leadership to identify trends, surface customer feedback, and shape process improvements that reduce friction and strengthen trust in Coinbase.  Mentor and support junior Concierge agents on relationship management, issue resolution, and best practices, raising the overall quality bar for the team.    Required Skills and Experience:    4+ years of experience in customer success, account management, or high-touch client advisory roles within financial services, fintech, or crypto, including familiarity with derivatives products.  Professional fluency in both Mandarin and English, with the ability to communicate confidently in a business and customer-facing capacity.  Demonstrated ability to independently manage a portfolio of high-value client relationships, with measurable outcomes in retention, satisfaction, or revenue growth, including resolving complex cross-functional issues end to end.  Currently holds or has previously held a CISI Investment Operations Certificate (IOC), or willingness to obtain. Z naszego produktu na co dzień korzysta ponad 65 tysięcy Użytkowników, którzy dbają o bezpieczeństwo medyczne Polski.  W związku z otwarciem nowego obszaru w naszej organizacji, poszukujemy doświadczonego CS Managera, który od podstaw zbuduje i poprowadzi naszą strukturę  Customer Success. Jest to rola hybrydowa w trybie 2 dni pracy w biurze + 3 dni pracy zdalnej.    Jakie zadania na Ciebie czekają?    Budowanie i Architektura Procesów CS Od Podstaw     Mapowanie i projektowanie pełnego ścieżki klienta (Customer Journey) - od momentu domknięcia sprzedaży po wieloletnią współpracę.  Tworzenie i wdrażanie kluczowych procesów CS: onboardingu klientów, strategii retencji, działań anty-churnowych.  Wdrażanie i dostosowanie narzędzi klasy CS / CRM do potrzeb nowo powstających procesów.  Zdefiniowanie wskaźników sukcesu (KPI/OKRs dla obszaru CS).     Tworzenie i Rozwój Zespołu     Budowanie i skalowanie nowej struktury zespołu Customer Success (rekrutacja, onboarding pracowników, ustalanie standardów pracy).  Bieżące wsparcie, coaching i wyznaczanie kierunków rozwoju dla przyszłych członków zespołu CS.  Egzekwowanie najwyższych standardów jakości w kontaktach z klientami i prowadzeniu spotkań biznesowych.     Podejście sprzedażowe i rozwój klientów     Współpraca przy budowaniu i optymalizacji lejków sprzedażowych wewnątrz istniejącej bazy klientów.  Aktywny udział w kluczowych lub trudniejszych rozmowach biznesowych i negocjacjach umów.  Łączenie doskonałej obsługi i edukacji klienta z budowaniem wartości biznesowej (zwiększanie adopcji produktów)     Współpraca Strategiczna     Ścisła współpraca ze strukturami Globalnymi / Zarządem w zakresie raportowania, dostosowywania procesów i wdrażania inicjatyw.  Merytoryczne wsparcie dla zespołów Sales, Expansion oraz Customer Care w celu zapewnienia spójnego doświadczenia klienta.  Współtworzenie długoterminowej strategii wzrostu firmy w oparciu o feedback i potrzeby klientów.     Kogo szukamy?    Doświadczenie     Poparte sukcesami doświadczenie w budowaniu od zera lub gruntownej przebudowie obszaru Customer Success / Account Management.  Min. 2 lata doświadczenia w zarządzaniu zespołami CS lub sprzedażowymi (SaaS / B2B).  Tło sprzedażowe i biznesowe (znajomość mechanizmów upsellu, negocjacji i zarządzania wskaźnikiem churn).  Doświadczenie w tworzeniu procesów, procedur oraz wdrażaniu narzędzi wspomagających pracę CS.     Kompetencje i Cechy Osobowościowe     Wysoka sprawczość i inicjatywa duża samodzielność, inicjatywa i wysoka odporność na zmianę oraz pracę w środowisku o niskim stopniu ustrukturyzowania na starcie.

description: ABOUT THE ROLE  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------  HitPay builds omnichannel payment infrastructure for growing businesses across  Asia-Pacific. Tens of thousands of businesses use us to accept payments online and  in person, across Singapore, Malaysia, the Philippines and beyond.  This is a new role, and the first of its kind here. You will own the relationship  between HitPay and the businesses already using us — making sure they get set up  properly, stay successful, and tell us when something is not working.  The remit is regional. Your book spans every market we operate in, not one country,  and it grows as we open new ones. That means learning what "unhappy" looks like in  markets with different payment habits, different competitors and different  expectations about how quickly money should arrive — and spotting when a problem is  local versus when it is ours everywhere.  It sits deliberately between teams. Support handles day-to-day questions.  Compliance owns verification and risk. Sales brings new businesses in. You own  what happens to a partner across all three, which is where good businesses are  most easily lost.  WHAT YOU WILL OWN  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------  1. Partner health  Work a prioritised list of partners who need attention — because they have hit  friction, gone quiet, or told us they are unhappy. Reach out, diagnose, and  either resolve or escalate. Every partner on that list gets an owner and an  outcome, not a status.  2. The first 90 days  A business that signs up and never reaches steady processing has been lost just  as surely as one that leaves loudly, and far more quietly. Own activation from  first transaction to established volume: what stalls, why, and what unblocks it.  3. Retention and win-backs  Run retention conversations directly, including commercial discussions where  the case supports one. Reopen conversations with partners who have gone quiet.  4. The feedback loop  Take root causes back to the teams that own them — product, pricing,  compliance, support — with evidence attached. Push for the change, and follow  it through. This is the part of the job most likely to be neglected and most  likely to matter.  5. Measurement  Define how we measure partner retention and activation across markets, report  it on a regular cadence, and keep it honest.  WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------  The remit spans onboarding, support and compliance handoffs, so boundaries matter.  You own the partner's outcome across these seams — you do not take over the  functions themselves.  · Not verification or onboarding review. Compliance owns approval, rejection and risk decisions. title: Client Success Partner - Dutch speaking (must be fluent)
description: About the role:     The Client Success team follows a Client for Life Philosophy, and individuals in this role ensure that every Gartner client receives value far exceeding their investment. At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world. title: Onboarding Manager (f/m/x)
description: Graneet   est une plateforme SaaS qui facilite le quotidien des dirigeants de la construction en leur donnant accès à un pilotage précis de leur activité pour optimiser leur marge et éviter aussi les faillites. Nos clients sont les meilleurs ambassadeurs de notre solution, regarde 👀   ici   les avis qu’ils laissent sur nous ! Elle est structurée ainsi :   Un pôle Onboarding : l’équipe gère la prise en main des clients avec notre plateforme jusqu’à l’activation de nos clients  Un pôle Customer Success : l'équipe pilote la relation client dans la durée, travaille à l'adoption du produit et favorise l'engagement, anticipe les risques de churn, et identifie les opportunités de croissance  Un pôle Care : l'équipe est le premier point de contact de nos utilisateurs, elle traite chaque demande avec réactivité et s'assure qu'aucun sujet ne reste sans réponse   Nous recherchons une nouvelle recrue dans l'équipe Onboarding de  Nicolas , Team Lead Onboarding et tu travailleras étroitement avec  Elisa  et  Margot .      🎯 Tes missions 🎯       Customer Activation    Après un brief de l’Account Executive qui a vendu l’abonnement à Graneet, tu deviens l’interlocuteur de confiance du nouveau client et de ses équipes.  Dès le premier jour, tu mets en place une stratégie de déploiement mid-touch qui permettra au client d’atteindre ses objectifs.  Paramétrage, formations, import de données : tu mobilises toutes les ressources nécessaires pour assurer le bon déroulement de l’onboarding.    Suivi de l'Activation    Tu mesures les indicateurs d’activation de ton portefeuille clients et tu mets en place les actions nécessaires pour accélérer le  Time To Value.   Lorsque le client est pleinement opérationnel, assurer un transfert de dossier clair et structuré vers les équipes Customer Success en charge du suivi long terme. Recueillir les retours d’expérience pour identifier les axes d’amélioration du produit.  Transmettre les feedbacks pertinents aux équipes Produit et Développement.    Documentation et support    Tu contribues à structurer et améliorer les étapes de l’onboarding pour nos clients sur les différents plans avec le reste de l’équipe.  Tu participes ponctuellement au support client (1 demie-journée par mois).       💎Profil recherché 💎       Tu as au moins 3 ans d’expérience professionnelle en tant que Customer Success Manager avec une dominante sur l’onboarding.  Tu as travaillé dans un environnement SaaS, idéalement B2B.  Tu sais convaincre et embarquer tes interlocuteurs : le  change

title: Solutions Transitie en Implementatiemanager
description: Securitas ontwikkelt zich als solutions-gedreven organisatie met als doel wereldwijd marktleider te zijn in Security Solutions. Vanuit Solutions Delivery realiseert de organisatie complexe integrale beveiligingsoplossingen waarin technologie, mobiele surveillance, monitoring en beveiliging samenkomen. De afdeling vormt de schakel tussen sales, operatie en klant en is verantwoordelijk voor de succesvolle implementatie van deze oplossingen. Door de groei van de dienstverlening, de ontwikkeling van medewerkers en de toenemende impact op de organisatie is deze functie ontstaan. De internationale Solutions-organisatie biedt daarnaast interessante doorgroeimogelijkheden.  Als Solutions Transitie- en Implementatiemanager maak je deel uit van de afdeling Solutions Delivery. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de succesvolle implementatie van integrale beveiligingsoplossingen bij strategische klanten. Deze oplossingen bestaan uit een combinatie van technologie, monitoring, mobiele surveillance, manbeveiliging en aanvullende security services, afgestemd op de specifieke risico's, dreigingen en bedrijfsprocessen van de klant.  Je bent al betrokken tijdens de salesfase en neemt na opdrachtverstrekking de regie over het implementatietraject. Je fungeert als centraal aanspreekpunt voor zowel klanten als interne stakeholders, valideert de ontwikkelde oplossing, stelt projectplannen op en zorgt voor een succesvolle overdracht naar de operationele organisatie. In deze rol ligt de nadruk op regievoering: je brengt commerciële, operationele en technische disciplines samen, stemt belangen af en zorgt ervoor dat alle betrokken partijen effectief samenwerken aan een succesvolle implementatie van de overeengekomen oplossing.  Bij wijzigingen in klantwensen of projectscope analyseer je de impact op zowel de klantorganisatie als Securitas. Je signaleert risico's, stuurt tijdig bij en zorgt ervoor dat projecten gecontroleerd, beheerst en succesvol verlopen.   Daarnaast Ben Je Verantwoordelijk Voor     Planning, kwaliteit, klanttevredenheid en risicobeheersing  Bewaking van financiële kaders  Realisatie van contractuele afspraken, KPI’s en SLA’s  Transparante rapportages richting klanten en interne stakeholders  Je signaleert verbeterkansen in processen, dienstverlening en samenwerking en draagt actief bij aan de verdere professionalisering van Solutions Delivery  Kennis van en ervaring me project methoden  Minimaal een afgeronde HBO-opleiding en relevante werkervaring  Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met het leiden van complexe implementatie-, transitie- of deliveryprojecten  Ervaring met multi-service deliveryprocessen en multidisciplinaire implementatietrajecten  Ervaring met KPI’s, SLA’s en contractafspraken  Affiniteit met de securitywereld en techniek  Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal  Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om verschillende belangen samen te brengen  Ervaring met stakeholdermanagement en verandertrajecten  Deze rol past

title: Head of Finance & Data (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Aufgaben

Zahlen sind deine Leidenschaft, und du willst die Datenbasis dahinter nicht nur nutzen, sondern selbst gestalten? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig. Als Head of Finance & Data (m/w/d) bist du das strategische und technische Fundament für unser weiteres Wachstum.

In dieser vielseitigen Doppelrolle verbindest du messerscharfe Zahlenkompetenz mit einem echten Gespür für Datenarchitektur und Reporting-Infrastruktur. Du baust nicht nur ein stabiles Controlling auf, sondern gestaltest parallel die technische Grundlage, auf der unser gesamtes Unternehmen datenbasierte Entscheidungen trifft. Kurz: Du hältst uns den Rücken frei und lenkst aktiv unseren Erfolgskurs mit.

  • Strukturen schaffen: Du baust belastbare Controlling-Strukturen und Reportings mit einer klaren, zukunftsorientierten Steuerungslogik auf.
  • Finanzen im Griff: Du übernimmst die Gesamtverantwortung für unsere Finanzplanung, das Reporting und die strategische finanzielle Steuerung.
  • Data-Infrastruktur gestalten: Du treibst den Aufbau unserer automatisierten Datenpipelines voran (u. a. BigQuery, angebunden an Shopify, Klaviyo und weitere Quellen) und sorgst dafür, dass Kennzahlen zuverlässig, aktuell und zentral verfügbar sind.
  • BI & Controlling verzahnen: Du entwickelst unsere Dashboards und Reporting-Tools (z. B. Looker Studio) so weiter, dass Finance-Kennzahlen und operative Daten in einem konsistenten Bild zusammenlaufen.
  • Prozesse skalieren: Du etablierst effiziente, smarte Prozesse im Finance- und Data-Bereich, die mit uns mitwachsen.
  • Sparring auf Augenhöhe: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem CEO zusammen und berätst ihn als geschätzter Sparringspartnerin in allen strategischen Finanz- und Datenfragen.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer - B2B platform (Laravel + Nuxt/Vue)
description:
About ScholarshipOwl

ScholarshipOwl is the largest scholarship marketplace in the US, using AI to connect 14 million students who are looking for scholarships with companies that are looking for students. Our mission is to make education financing more accessible and engaging, while giving brands a way to connect with the next generation.

We’re powered by AI technology that simplifies scholarship discovery, streamlines the application process, and delivers measurable results for both students and partners. Whether it’s helping students secure funding or enabling brands to run impactful campaigns, we’re reshaping how education is funded — and discovered.


The Role

We’re looking for a highly skilled and innovative Senior Full-Stack Engineer to architect high-performance web applications and accelerate our development velocity across our B2B platform. You’ll play a pivotal role in bridging modern Nuxt 3/4 frontend applications—including customer management portals and embeddable widget engines—with a robust Laravel and Doctrine ORM backend API, delivering seamless experiences that connect millions of students to funding opportunities.

You will own the technical implementation of core products across our entire stack, working with PHP 8.2+, Laravel, MySQL, and Vue 3 / Nuxt 3/4. Beyond traditional engineering, this role champions efficiency: you will deeply integrate AI-native workflows (using tools like Cursor and Google Gemini) to double shipping velocity, automate test coverage, and build intelligent LLM-driven platform features. If you are passionate about full-stack architecture, widget infrastructure, and leveraging AI to build smarter and faster, this role is for you.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Forward Deployed Engineers turn what Luma's models can do into systems customers actually rely on. You embed with a customer, learn their workflow, define the problem with them, and build the production system that solves it, with their data and their constraints. You own both the relationship and the code.

This is engineering at the edge, where ambiguity is the default and "what should we build?" is yours to answer. It's built for people who've already been the single point of ownership on a hard problem: a technical founder, the engineer who flew out and rebuilt a customer's workflow, a consultant who actually wrote the system.   • Work directly with customers to understand their workflows, constraints, and goals, and define the problem yourself.

  • Own projects end to end, from first conversation to deployed system.

  • Use AI to accelerate implementation, while the core of the work stays engineering judgment: what to build and how to make it reliable.

title: Senior Software Engineer  (Java)
description:
About ARQ

ARQ is one of the fastest-growing fintechs in the world. Our mission is to redefine how people interact with money across borders, building the infrastructure to move value seamlessly. We’re still early in our journey, which means every person who joins shapes the future of our product, culture, and growth. If you’re excited by big challenges, global impact, and the chance to grow fast with a world-class team, ARQ is the place to do it.

What we're looking for

As a Backend Engineer, you’ll design, develop, and maintain scalable, secure, and high-performing backend systems that power our innovative products. You’ll collaborate with a talented team to create solutions that drive financial inclusion and transform the way people manage their money.

What you'll be doing

  • The work will focus on greenfield development and improvement of existing systems

  • Projects will include building REST APIs, engineering microservices and evolving a number of systems that our business depends on (e.g. card payments, treasury management, transactions booking, crypto liquidity)

  • Our technology stack is based predominantly on Java 25 on the backend with Postgres database

  • We rely on Spring Boot for quick and quality delivery

  • We have a pragmatic approach to develop our business logic, focusing on clean code, with emphasis on maintainability and fast turnaround with TDD, DDD and continuous integration & delivery

What you'll need

  • Demonstrable experience in Backend development, with fluency in Java

The Mission: Source.dev

Our founders spent over a decade at Google shaping the Android operating systems - building and shipping the software that now runs on billions of devices. They didn't just use Android; they led teams responsible for the Android Virtualization Framework, Security, and the Android Runtime (ART).

Through that journey, they saw a quiet but massive crisis: as device software grew in complexity, the tools used to build it remained stuck in the past. Today, a standard Android checkout exceeds 200GB of code, and builds can take hours. This "wait time" is the single biggest tax on innovation.

Source.dev was founded to reimagine software development workflows for device makers. We’re building a new generation of software tools that make building complex device software feel as simple as building a webpage - starting with SourceFS.

The Core Product: SourceFS

SourceFS is a high-performance virtual filesystem designed to turn multi-hour workflows into minutes.

  • 10x Faster Builds: Intelligent caching and virtualization that only materializes files when they are actually needed.

title: Product Lead - AI Stockbroking App
description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

Your users are engineers.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
⭐️ Your Impact:

The European trades are one of the least digitised industries left. Software
penetration sits under 15%, against roughly 70% in the US. The labour
productivity gap runs about 30%. Millions of skilled people spend their evenings
on paperwork instead of the craft they trained for — in the industry that has to
deliver the energy transition.

There is almost no incumbent software to displace. That is unusual, and it won't
last.

smalt replaces the back office entirely rather than selling Meister another tool
to manage. In the last six months that went from a partner app and a dashboard
to around thirty AI agents in production - pricing real jobs, qualifying real
leads, running the operations of businesses whose payroll depends on it working.

These days building thirty agents is easy. Knowing which thirty is what's challenging.

That only comes from being in the Betrieb and talking to the Handwerker.

That's what this role is for.

What you'll do

You'll sit in Handwerksbetrieben - at the Meister's desk, in the van, on site, next to our team -
and watch how the work actually happens. Then you'll come back and build the
thing that fixes it, often multiple times on the same day.

- Spend real time with partners. Not a quarterly customer call. You'll know
  our Meister by name, understand their P&L, and notice the thing they've
  stopped complaining about because they assume it can't be fixed.
- Build across the stack. Python/FastAPI services, Vue interfaces, Flutter
  screens, agent loops, data pipelines - whatever the problem needs.
- Own agents in production. Not demos. Agents that price real jobs, answer
  real customers, and cost real money when they're wrong. Reliability,
  evaluation, structured output, graceful failure.
- Decide what to build.

title: Teammanager Klantenservice
description: Hoe maak jij onze klanten blij?   Als Teammanager Klantenservice binnen De Service Hub zorg je ervoor dat klanten vandaag goed geholpen worden én dat de klantenservice van morgen steeds slimmer, beter en mensgerichter wordt. Je geeft leiding aan een team van ongeveer 20 Service Experts en speelt daarnaast een belangrijke rol in het verbeteren van processen, samenwerking en kwaliteit. Met jouw coachende stijl, scherpe blik en gevoel voor operatie help je niet alleen je team vooruit, maar versterk je ook de dienstverlening als geheel.   De grootste uitdaging   De Service Hub is binnen bol dé plek waar vernieuwing in klantcontact tastbaar wordt. Nieuwe processen, systemen en werkwijzen worden hier vaak als eerste getest, aangescherpt en gevalideerd. Dat maakt deze rol breder dan alleen operationeel leidinggeven.  Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse performance van je team, maar kijkt ook continu vooruit: wat kan slimmer, beter of menselijker? Daarom zoeken we geen manager die alleen op output stuurt, maar iemand die ontwikkeling stimuleert, eigenaarschap vergroot en samen met anderen bouwt aan blijvend betere service.   Wat je doet   Je combineert people management met procesverbetering en kwaliteitssturing. Je helpt medewerkers groeien, creëert een omgeving waarin feedback en ontwikkeling centraal staan en zorgt dat jouw team stevig staat in een dynamische serviceomgeving.  Daarnaast werk je nauw samen met andere teammanagers, specialisten en projectteams om inzichten uit de praktijk te vertalen naar verbeteringen die verder reiken dan je eigen team.   Waarom jij het verschil kunt maken      Je coacht en ontwikkelt Service Experts, zowel individueel als op teamniveau, zodat zij met vertrouwen en eigenaarschap hun werk kunnen doen.   Je creëert een veilige en open werkomgeving waarin samenwerken, leren en feedback centraal staan.   Je monitort prestaties, kwaliteit en klantfeedback en vertaalt signalen naar concrete verbeteracties.   Je draagt samen met je team bij aan pilots en verbeterinitiatieven rondom processen, systemen en klantcontact.   Je vertegenwoordigt de stem van de operatie binnen grotere, bol-brede projecten en helpt mee aan toekomstbestendige service.   Je werkt intensief samen met andere teammanagers en specialisten om de afdeling als geheel sterker te maken.     Hier kom je terecht   Je komt terecht in De Service Hub in Utrecht: een omgeving waar klantcontact, innovatie en ontwikkeling samenkomen. Hier wordt continu getest, geleerd en verbeterd. Dat vraagt om mensen die nieuwsgierig zijn, verantwoordelijkheid nemen en graag samenwerken.  Je werkt hybride, met minimaal 2 dagen per week op kantoor. Woensdag is de vaste kantoordag binnen De Service Hub. Omdat de klantenservice 7 dagen per week bereikbaar is van 08.00 tot 23.00 uur, draai je ook avond- en weekenddiensten en maak je samen met de andere teammanagers het rooster.   Something for you?     Als je...: energie krijgt van het coachen en ontwikkelen van mensen en tea

title: Staff Design Engineer - UK
description:
Hi I’m Abhik, Ashby's Co-Founder and VP of Engineering. This role is close to my heart because, as someone who can both design and code, it’s where I’ve always done my best work, but also where I was seen as a rebel and an outsider. I want folks like me to feel at home at Ashby, and so I made Design Engineering a formal role and department that works closely with me. Our first hire was over five years ago, and we’re doubling the team from five to over ten in the next year.

This role truly expects you to design and code. Design Engineer at Ashby isn’t just a Frontend Engineer with new branding, nor is it a Designer vibe coding prototypes. Combining excellence in both is where magic happens. I found that when I put my best effort into both the design and technical implementation of a feature, I had a nimbleness and creativity that was hard to achieve when I did only one or the other. For instance, the UX and UI I envisioned often influenced the data model's design and flexibility, while the understanding of technology's capabilities often simplified or improved the design. This role embraces that.

You’ll work on our most challenging design problems, help others improve their designs by expanding and enhancing our in-house design system, and consult on bespoke design work needed by Product Engineers. To ground it with examples, Design Engineers at Ashby have:

  • Redesigned our mobile web app by talking with customers who use it often, wireframing new flows, implementing its design system, and using that system to turn the wireframes into a polished UI.

  • Built a set of flexible, composable components in our design system that allow other engineers to build beautiful, consistent setup wizards across our product easily.

  • Helped a Product Engineer improve the information hierarchy and scannability of their design for viewing a candidate’s assessments. Recruiters can quickly parse information and pick out anomalies.

The Design Engineer role is more common today than five years ago, but I believe Ashby offers a unique opportunity that few can match:

  • You work on a product at scale, not at an early-stage startup struggling to find users and get feedback on what you’ve designed and built. At Ashby, your work will touch over 100,000 weekly active users, millions of candidates per week, and notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. You’ll get to test out ideas with our own recruiting team and hiring managers who use Ashby every day (like me), and often hear customer feedback as early as the day you release.

  • This role has always had the commitment of both Benji (CEO & Co-Founder) and me: I’ve held the role, steadfastly championed it since we started hiring in 2020, and haven’t diluted its responsibilities as we’v

Der Fachkräftemangel ist real, die Digitalisierung in diesem Bereich steckt noch in den Kinderschuhen, und die Lösungen, die es heute gibt, sind nicht für die Nutzer gebaut, die sie eigentlich brauchen.

Das wollen wir ändern.

Wir bauen gerade eine digitale Plattform auf, die den medizinischen Arbeitsmarkt im DACH-Raum neu strukturiert. Was du bei uns machen wirst:

title: Software Security Engineer*
description:

  • Du konzipierst, entwickelst und implementierst Softwarelösungen, in dem du AI-Methoden und Tools im gesamten Softwareentwicklungsprozess anwendest (z.B. LLMs, agentische Frameworks, Codegenerierung und Testautomatisierung)

  • Du verfügst über Erfahrung und Expertise in der sicheren Software Entwicklung, um Best Principles und Practices für sichere Softwareentwicklung, z. B. NCSC, OWASP oder Mitre, in den Projekten einzusetzen und an uns anzupassen

  • Du arbeitest mit modernen Technologien wie C#, Java, JavaScript, Spring oder Vue – je nach deinen Stärken und Interessen bringst du einen Teil davon in unsere Projekte ein und bist verantwortlich für die IT-Sicherheit

  • Du entwirfst und baust sichere Infrastrukturen in der Cloud (z. B. AWS, Azure, IONOS, Google) für die von uns entwickelten Anwendungen

  • Du hast einen Hochschulabschluss in Informatik oder in einer vergleichbaren Disziplin erfolgreich abgeschlossen​

  • Du bringst tiefgehende, praktische Kenntnisse im Software Engineering mit und fühlst dich sowohl im Backend als auch im Frontend wohl

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
Coup verschafft innovativen Unternehmen einfachen Zugang zu staatlichen Fördermitteln. Dafür entwickeln wir eine leistungsstarke Softwareplattform und kombinieren sie mit exzellenter persönlicher Beratung. So wird die Beantragung und Abrechnung von R&D Förderungen für unsere Kund:innen einfach und bequem.

Bei Coup sind wir der Go-to-Partner für die Beantragung und Abwicklung der Forschungszulage (FZuL) in Deutschland und haben damit seit 2021 mehr als 300 Unternehmen über 150 Mio. Euro Fördermittel gesichert.

Join us and help more companies get Couped!

Unser Sales war lange Founder-led. Das ändert sich jetzt. Für unsere nächste Wachstumsphase suchen wir eine kommerzielle, strukturierte Person, die unseren Outbound-Sales aufbaut, Leads konsequent durch die Pipeline führt und Deals gemeinsam mit unserem R&D Consulting Team über die Ziellinie bringt.

Aufgaben

Als (Sales Development Representative bist du der zweite Sales-Hire bei Coup und Teil unseres Revenue Teams, bestehend aus Marketing, Sales und Partnerships. Du berichtest direkt an unsere CRO, Theresa, und arbeitest eng mit unserem Account Executive, Maxi, sowie unserem R&D Consulting Team zusammen.

Dein Ziel: Durch den systematischen Aufbau unserer Outbound-Kanäle und einer disziplinierten Pipeline-Steuerung eine skalierbare Neukundengewinnung zu etablieren, die Coup als vertrauenswürdigen Go-to-Partner für die Forschungszulage stärkt und maßgeblich zu unseren Umsatzzielen beiträgt.

title: Senior Product Designer - Platform and Partner Experience
description:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to join the Partner and Platform Experience (PPX) team. You'll tackle problems where social dynamics, device ecosystems, and technical constraints intersect. It's work that demands systems thinking, deep comfort with technical complexity, and a drive to make complex interactions feel simple and engaging.


What You'll Do

  • Design experiences that help listeners share moments together and move effortlessly between the devices and platforms around them.

  • Own complex design problems from early exploration through execution, balancing user needs, technical constraints, and product opportunities.

  • Create thoughtful, polished user experiences with a strong focus on interaction design, visual craft, and the details that make an experience feel intuitive.

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering to understand the technology behind the experience and turn complex systems into simple experiences for listeners.

  • Explore how experiences scale across mobile, desktop, TVs, speakers, cars, and other surfaces in the Spotify ecosystem.

  • Use prototyping to explore, communicate, and test ideas, including AI-assisted and code-based approaches where they help us learn faster.

title: Senior Product Data Analyst - Consumer Growth
description:
About the team

SumUp is best known for helping small businesses get paid — our Consumer tribe builds the other half of that story. We make SumUp Consumer, the wallet app that lets everyday consumers pay SumUp merchants with a tap, send money to friends, track their spending and earn loyalty rewards along the way.

As we grow SumUp Consumer across new markets and features, we need sharp, reliable insight into how people discover, adopt and use the product — and how that behaviour translates into sustainable commercial growth. This includes understanding our acquisition funnel, improving activation and conversion, increasing customer value, and reducing churn.

We're looking for a Product Data Analyst to join the Consumer tribe and become the analytical partner for SumUp Consumer. You'll work closely with Product Managers, Designers and Engineers, alongside our Analytics Engineering team, to understand customer behaviour, shape product strategy, and connect product performance to business outcomes.

You'll help answer questions such as:

  • Which acquisition channels and customer segments generate the strongest long-term value?
  • Where do customers drop out of the journey from acquisition to activation?
  • What drives repeat usage, retention and churn?
  • Which product changes improve conversion, customer value or commercial performance?
  • How should we prioritise product investments across markets and customer segments?

If you're motivated by meaningful analytical work, enjoy translating complexity into clarity, and want to see your insights directly influence both product decisions and commercial outcomes, this role is for you.

What you'll do

  • Analyse customer behaviour and product performance across the full consumer lifecycle — from acquisition and activation through engagement, retention, churn and reactivation.

Pammys ist eine der am schnellsten gewachsenen D2C-Footwear-Brands Deutschlands – mit über 1,3 Millionen Kundinnen und Kunden und über 4 Millionen Euro Paid-Social-Spend pro Monat. Reporting & Self-Service. Du baust Dashboards, die benutzt werden – vom täglichen Steuerungsboard der Gründer bis zu Self-Service-Auswertungen für die Teams. Dein Anspruch: Jede wichtige Frage ist in Sekunden beantwortet, nicht in Meetings.

title: (Mandatory) Internship Technical Founder's Associate (m/w/d)
description:
About CyFract

We are a deep-tech startup on a mission to fundamentally change how we treat the world's most valuable resource: water. Founded in 2022, we develop a patented uniflow hydrocyclone that removes suspended solids without membranes, consumables or moving parts, at a fraction of the energy conventional systems require. Having completed the UnternehmerTUM Incubator and a €3M project financed by SPRIN-D (German Federal Agency for Disruptive Innovation), we successfully deployed two containerized pilot systems and are conducting validation projects with industrial partners. We are now building the team that will carry this from working prototype to industrial standard, and we are looking for the people who want to build it with us.

The Role

As Technical Founder's Associate, you will work directly with the founding team on our core technology. Over the coming months our separation geometry will be tested with pilot partners. You will be one of the people who builds the test setup, runs the measurements, and turns the results into something we can act on. This is not a role where you reproduce something that already works. Parts of what you build will be the first of their kind, and some of them will fail. We are looking for someone who finds that interesting rather than alarming. You will sit close to the founding team and see how an early stage company actually runs: how decisions get made, what gets prioritised and why, and what a founder's week really looks like. Your measurements and your judgement feed directly into those decisions.

Tasks

  • Build, modify and operate our Munich test rig; run and document test series
  • Design and iterate cyclone and guide-vane geometries in CAD and prepare print-ready files
  • 3D print, post-process, assemble and pressure-test prototypes
  • Build out the measurement chain: sensors, data acquisition, evaluation

title: Chief of Staff (m/w/d)
description:
P3A is a multi-platform operating and investment group building the infrastructure of tomorrow. Entrepreneurial at its core, P3A builds, owns, and backs the companies behind the assets the modern world depends on, bringing long-term capital and deep operational expertise to how critical infrastructure is built, operated, and financed. P3A was founded by serial entrepreneur Jannes Fischer in 2023.

Your Role

As Chief of Staff (m/w/d), you will be the right-hand and sparring partner of our founder Jannes Fischer and the person who holds the P3A group together internally. Your mission is to drive the build-out of the platform across its verticals, from the venture fund to company building to the group’s own asset base.

You will validate and launch new companies alongside Jannes, develop and execute investment strategies across asset classes, run the venture fund end-to-end, and orchestrate the tax advisors, lawyers, investors, and service providers around the group.

This is an entrepreneurial role with exceptional freedom and full ownership. It is built for a generalist with an investor’s mindset who is as comfortable in a cap table or shareholder agreement as in the operational day-to-day, thinks in structures, and executes hands-on without a team behind them.

  • Structuring: Set up legal and corporate structures, cap tables, and financing rounds for new ventures

description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

We design, develop, and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are software-defined, mass-scalable, and cost-effective, changing how autonomous systems are deployed across multiple domains. This gives our operators a decisive edge in highly contested environments. As threats rise, STARK is strengthening the technological edge of NATO Allies and their Partners to deter aggression and defend Europe.


About the team

Du wirst Teil unseres Teams an der Schnittstelle zwischen internationalem Handel, Exportkontrolle und dem operativen Tagesgeschäft bei STARK. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus verschiedenen Bereichen wie Vertrieb, Einkauf und Logistik zusammen. Von Anfang an arbeitest du an realen Fällen und sammelst praktische Erfahrung in einem schnelllebigen internationalen Umfeld.


Your mission

Als Werkstudent im Bereich Exportkontrolle unterstützt du uns dabei, nationale und internationale Exportkontrollvorgaben zuverlässig in unsere täglichen Geschäftsprozesse zu integrieren.

Du arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen Fachabteilungen wie Vertrieb, Einkauf und Logistik zusammen und unterstützt bei konkreten Fragestellungen rund um Exportgenehmigungen, Sanktionen, Güterklassifizierungen und länderbezogene Restriktionen.

Dabei erhältst du direkten Einblick in reale Fälle des internationalen Handels- und Exportkontrollrechts und kannst dein theoretisches Wissen unmittelbar in der Praxis anwenden.


Responsibilities

  • Du beantwortest tägliche Fragen aus Fachabteilungen, zum Beispiel Vertrieb, Einkauf und Logistik, zu exportkontrollrelevanten Abläufen und Prüfschritten.

description:
What you will do:

As the (Senior) Collection Merchandiser for the Shoes category, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the strategic direction of the footwear assortment. 

This role requires a deep understanding of luxury fashion, strong collaboration skills, and the ability to drive innovation while maintaining the brand's identity. You will work closely with the design, product development, sales, marketing, and operations teams to create a cohesive and successful shoe collection that meets the needs of both direct-to-consumer (D2C) and business-to-business (B2B) channels.

Collection Creation:
  • Lead the seasonal collection creation process for Shoes, working in close partnership with the design and product development teams.
  • Ensure the collection reflects the brand's DNA, resonates with target customers, and meets commercial objectives.
  • Own the range and the line plan and ensure they are constantly updated.
Critical Path Management:
  • Own the critical path for the Shoes category, ensuring all key milestones and deadlines are met.
  • Schedule and coordinate all relevant meetings, ensuring appropriate stakeholders are involved and prepared.
Cross-Functional Collaboration:
  • Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to develop compelling campaigns and product stories that enhance the visibility and desirability of the Shoes category.
  • Work with sales teams to gather feedback from wholesale partners and clients, ensuring their needs are reflected in the assortment.

Cross-Sell, Replenishment, Winback) und hebst so systematisch Kundenbindung und Customer Lifetime Value. Du arbeitest eng mit dem Performance-Marketing Team und den Gründerinnen zusammen und spielst deine Erkenntnisse aktiv ins Team zurück. Du kennst Klaviyo und Shopify aus dem Effeff – Flows, Segmentierung, dynamische Inhalte, A/B-Tests, Deliverability und Reporting. Our platform is the world's first Design Engagement System (DES) - a category defining product that Engineering teams use to engage in meaningful, productive design conversations, catch preventable mistakes, and get to market faster. Our customers include the largest engineering organizations in the world spanning from industrial equipment, consumer products, automotive, aerospace & defense, and shipbuilding industries. On-site visits have consistently driven higher adoption, deeper relationships, and better business outcomes for our customers. We recognize personal travel constraints may arise and we expect Strategic CSMs to proactively plan for and prioritize in-person opportunities. title: Head of Revenue (Sales and Customer Success)
location: Surry Hills, New South Wales, Australia
description: The short version Appetise has gone through a strong period of growth, with a product suite FMCG brands genuinely love and a team that has punched well above its weight.  The next chapter needs something we have never had: one person who owns the whole commercial engine. Sales and customer success, the systems underneath them, and the number at the end of it.  We are taking ANZ from $3-4M to $10M and opening the US. This is the role that makes the first part happen.  If you are currently one of several commercial leaders inside a large business, this is the job where you build the entire thing instead.    What Appetise does We help FMCG brands sell more.  Around 80% of new product launches die within 12-18 months, mostly because brands are guessing. They have no real visibility into how people actually shop, and no system for turning that into better decisions.  We have spent four years collecting genuine behavioural shopping data, and we turn it into two things brands pay for. A performance advertising channel that only charges them when we drive an actual sale in a supermarket, which is a first in this category. And an insights product that tells them what to build next.  Nobody else in the category has both. That is the whole business.  We raised an $8M Series A in late 2025. We are around 25 people across Australia and New Zealand, and we open the US in 2027.    Why this role exists now Our commercial growth so far has been founder-led. That is how most companies get to $3-5M. It is not how they get to $50M.  Today we have a sales team generating genuine pipeline, a customer success team our customers are loyal to, and marketers who think in unit economics. What we have never had is one person whose entire job is to bring those together, set the standard, and build the infrastructure that lets a team of eight become a team of twenty.  We are being straight with you about the stage. There is a lot to build here. No expansion playbook yet. No cross-sell/upsell motion. Reporting that needs work. Sales, CS and marketing that could talk to each other far better than they do.  That is either the reason you take this job or the reason you don't, and both answers are fine.    What you will own  Sales.  The number, and the function that hits it. Clear targets for every person. Enablement, coaching, pipeline discipline, and a forecast the business can rely on. You will hire the next AE and SDR as we grow. You are building something designed to scale, not managing what already exists.   Customer success, and specifically the commercial half of it.  Our CSMs have built genuinely deep relationships with our customers. The opportunity is turning that trust into growth. Renewals that are never a surprise. Customer health you can actually see. A real playbook for expansion and cross-sell, run by the team rather than by you. B. title: Engagement Manager
description: Why SailPoint?       Love what you do. And love where you do it. Smart people, fun culture, innovative work, beautiful offices — oh, and everyone’s really nice. That’s what people say about SailPoint. We’re known as the company where everyone wants to work, and we have the   awards   to prove it. If you’re passionate about outsmarting cybercriminals and working at a company where you can truly have an impact, and we want you to join our team.       SailPoint empowers the largest, most complex organizations by putting identity at the Centre of Security and IT.  Our 2,000+ customers include global financial institutions, government entities, and pharmaceutical organizations and more.       Who You Are:       You are a self-directed, highly motivated, and experienced professional that thrives while overseeing multiple projects and prospective client opportunities. It is easy for you to build and maintain professional working relationships, and you are comfortable interacting with people at all levels within an organization. You possess strong leadership, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills and can balance both team and individual workloads. You are an exceptional multitasker, with the ability to meet and manage moving deadlines, gauge risks, and creatively resolve unexpected issues that arise. By leveraging your experience, you can identify growth areas, evaluate existing best practices, and present solutions to everyday problems.        What You’ll Do:       As an  Engagement Manager  (EM) on SailPoint’s Professional Services team, you will support each customer’s journey by managing tactical project management duties and sales efforts required to deliver SailPoint solutions. You will combine your professional experience with our world-class product and process training to gain a deep understanding of SailPoint’s SaaS and/or Software delivery models.         Within the first two months   , you will begin to understand your responsibilities by working with tenured managers to shadow projects and begin taking accountability for the client experience on projects you are assigned to.       At the end of the first six months   , you will begin to take ownership and be responsible for engagement scoping, client communication, internal team coordination, and escalation support.       At the end of your first year   , you will be able to manage the full scope of customer engagements, set appropriate expectations, and be a trusted advisor to your peers.  You will also be a engagement leader to your team members, helping them set and achieve their goals. title: Customer Operations Manager

Since 2016 we have grown from a peer-to-peer platform into a pan-European business active across 15 markets, with local presence in Sweden, Finland and the United Kingdom — offering consumer lending, savings accounts backed by the national deposit guarantee scheme, and one of Europe's leading specialised platforms for managing unsecured non-performing loans. title: Customer Service Manager Scandinavia - Kiilto
description: A hands-on Customer Service role for you who enjoy daily operations, teamwork and continuous improvement.   At Kiilto, Customer Service plays an important role in creating a smooth and reliable customer experience. We are now looking for an experienced Customer Service or Supply Chain professional who enjoys working close to the daily business, leading the Scandinavian Customer Service team and helping improve common ways of working across the region.   Role Overview   In this role, you will lead Customer Service operations for the Scandinavian region, covering Kiilto’s markets in Denmark, Norway and Sweden. You will work closely with a small, experienced team and support high-quality service throughout the order-to-cash process.  The position combines coordination, daily operational work and continuous improvement. You will help set priorities, follow up on KPIs and support the team in meeting agreed service levels. You will also be involved in improving processes, systems and ways of working.  You will be part of an international Logistics and Warehousing team and collaborate with colleagues in Logistics, Supply Chain, Finance and the Business Areas. The role is focused on the Scandinavian region, while also contributing to selected regional and global improvement initiatives where relevant.   Your Key Responsibilities      Support and develop the Scandinavian Customer Service team in daily operations.   Ensure effective day-to-day Customer Service operations, including sales order management, claims handling and customer requests.   Set priorities, follow up on KPIs and support agreed service levels.   Improve and harmonize Customer Service processes and ways of working across the Scandinavian markets.   Support organizational and cultural change initiatives to enable effective cross-border collaboration.   Analyze Customer Service performance and implement corrective actions and improvements where needed.   Collaborate closely with Logistics, Warehousing, other parts of the supply chain function, Finance and Business Area teams to strengthen the overall order-to-cash process.   Contribute to regional and selected global improvement projects.     What We Expect      Relevant academic degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field, higher vocational education (KY/YH), or equivalent experience   Several years of experience in Customer Service operations, Supply Chain or a similar area.   Experience from working in an international team and supporting or leading people in a cross-cultural environment.   Experience of leading change and developing processes, systems and ways of working.   Strong analytical skills and experience using KPIs and data to drive performance and improvement.   Good understanding of ERP systems, Office tools and BI solutions.   Strong communication and collaboration skills in an international, cross-functional environment.   Fluency in English and Swedish.     Why Kiilto?

title: Seksjonsleder Kunde
description: Vi leter etter deg!  Har du lyst til å utgjøre en forskjell? For folk rundt deg og for klima og miljø? Da vil vi høre fra deg!  Det er fint om du er:  En trygg leder som får folk til å trives og jobbe godt sammen  God til å lytte, forstå ulike perspektiver og samle folk om felles mål  God til å kommunisere og skape gode relasjoner på tvers av fagområder    Vi tilbyr  En fleksibel og travel arbeidshverdag  Bra folk og et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø  Læring, utvikling og nye muligheter  Lønn som møter kompetansen din   Trygghet gjennom gode pensjon – og forsikringsordninger  Trivselstilbud og sosiale aktiviteter     Om å jobbe sammen med oss  I Linea jobber vi hver dag for at alle våre kunder skal ha en stabil og sikker strømforsyning, og levere strøm til over 47 000 kunder.   Hos oss finner du en mangfoldig gjeng med flinke kollegaer som brenner for å gjøre en forskjell. Vi jobber hardt for å sikre at folk har strøm i stikkontaktene sine, og for at strømmen overføres på en bærekraftig måte. Vi bygger ut mest mulig skånsomt i forhold til natur og miljø.  Vi jobber like hardt for å skape en god arbeidsplass, bygget på samarbeid og fellesskap. I Linea har vi lave skuldre, vi tar sikkerhet på største alvor og det er alltid noen som stiller opp når du trenger hjelp.  Det er viktig for hele organisasjonen å kunne forbedre seg, og hos oss har du mulighet til å utvikle deg personlig og faglig.  Om stillingen  I dag får 47 000 kunder tilført strøm fra Linea. Vi forvalter hele 8000 kilometer med strømlinjer; det tilsvarer Norge på langs – 3,5 ganger! Her gjør de flinke folka i seksjon Kunde en viktig jobb: 41 engasjerte medarbeidere med ansvar for kundehåndtering i Linea. Gjennom kundeseksjonen skal vi arbeide hver eneste dag for å optimalisere kundereisen i Linea, håndtere saker og forespørsler fra kunden, og følge opp våre anlegg i de tusen hjem og bedrifter på Helgeland.  Som leder av seksjon Kunde vil et være ditt oppdrag å sette mål, drifte og utvikle for seksjonen i samhandling med egen ledergruppe. I stillingen skal du inspirere medarbeidere, bygge gode team, og drive endringer der det er behov. I tillegg vil du være del av ledergruppen i Linea, og gjennom den rollen bidra til å videreutvikle selskapet på en god måte.  Som synlig leder i Linea er dine ansatte dine viktigste kunder, og du deler uoppfordret all din kunnskap og skaper trygghet ved å være åpen om egne feil og mangler. Du arbeider aktivt for å utvikle talenter i ditt eget team, og skaper resultater gjennom dine medarbeidere. Du vurderer og prioriterer Helgeland Kraft og Lineas omdømme høyt i alle sammenheng.  Dine arbeidsoppgaver  Personal-, resultat- og HMS ansvar for seksjonen  Som en av tre seksjonsledere i Linea bidra til utvikling og gjennomføring av strategi og mål for Linea  Utvikle ledergruppen i Kunde, samt sette mål for seksjonen og følge opp disse  Utvikle og forbedre systemer og rutiner i seksjoner i henhold til KF-krafta (vårt forretningssystem)  Organisere seksjone

title: Customer Success Manager
description: Coretura is building the software backbone for the next generation of commercial vehicles - a joint venture between two of the industry's biggest players, moving at scaleup speed. As Customer Success Manager, you'll sit at the center of that relationship, turning shareholder alignment into product momentum.    Our Vision & Mission   Coretura exists to build a Software Defined Vehicle (SDV) platform that redefines how commercial vehicles are engineered, updated, and monetized - jointly owned by Volvo Group and Daimler Truck, two competitors who are betting that shared infrastructure beats separate roads. Our mission is to deliver a common platform robust enough to serve multiple OEMs, while still giving each shareholder room to differentiate and win in their own markets. This is a company in active build-mode: fast-scaling, still shaping its own structures, and defined by the ambition to make software the center of gravity in trucking.   Your Quest   Coretura serves two OEM shareholders who are simultaneously its customers, a structural setup that creates constant, real tension: whose priorities get championed first, how do you keep a platform genuinely common when both owners want to differentiate, and what happens when one side's ask risks disadvantaging the other?  On top of that, the product itself is still under creation, and that creation often means guiding a broader shift from hardware-centric thinking toward a software-first mindset. We are building the platform and bringing the customers along for the ride at the same time, which makes for a different kind of relationship than you'd have with an established product. This calls for someone who can stay close to the customer commercially and relationally, build a genuine business case for why and how they engage with the platform, set and manage realistic expectations continuously, and be comfortable challenging the customer with integrity and assertiveness, all while never losing sight of the platform's value in the eyes of the customer.  This is where the Customer Success Manager comes in. You are the person who holds the customer relationship end-to-end, deeply representing your customer's interests, building the commercial and business rationale for their engagement with the platform, and making sure that rationale is heard by the people who shape the platform. The Customer Success Manager keeps their ears & eyes close to the customer organization, actively owning and driving the customer relationship to ensure a successful SDV platform in its rollout and operation.   The Value You Bring     You turn a structural relationship into a working partnership, so the customer feels heard, represented, and commercially engaged, not just serviced.  You manage expectations proactively around a product that's still being built, keeping the customer aligned and confident even as scope and timelines evolve.  You uncover customer needs early and turn them into concrete business opportunit

The Companion Animal Group (CAG) is responsible for installing and supporting our best-in-class premium instruments, including ProCyte, Catalyst One and SediVue, alongside the wider IDEXX analyzer portfolio. Our FSR team trains customers to get the most from their newly acquired instruments and provides onsite technical support when things don't go to plan. As a Field Support Manager, you'll build and develop this team so they can keep delivering excellent service across the region.   In This Role     You will lead and support the FSR team across the UK, contributing to FSR strategy, operating policies and process improvements.  You'll coach and develop individuals to deliver excellent customer experience, spotting opportunities and assigning the right resources.  You'll partner with field partners to identify opportunities and coordinate resources across the region.  You will guide territory management, helping the team prioritise and allocate their time so internal and external customers stay satisfied.  You'll join ride-alongs with field reps to provide hands-on training and individual development.  You will use data, metrics and system tools to drive efficiency and maximise customer experience.  You'll act as a change champion, supporting the team through periods of change.  You will evaluate performance and provide ongoing coaching and development opportunities.  You'll help representatives organise travel to customers, resolve issues, and keep site-visit reporting timely and accurate.  You've worked cross-functionally with other departments to coordinate work, resolve issues, and share customer feedback into product and process improvements.     Why This Role Matters   Our Field Support Representatives are often the face of IDEXX for our customers — the people who install, train and troubleshoot the instruments that help vets diagnose and treat companion animals every day. As Field Support Manager, you'll be at the heart of ensuring that team performs at its best, directly shaping the experience our customers have with IDEXX and supporting the continued growth of our European operations.   What You Need To Succeed     5-7+ years of related work experience, with in-depth experience in a supervised field or business support environment.  3+ years of supervisory experience, or a combination of supervisory and relevant product knowledge.  Experience supervising remote, multi-site teams.  Strong project management and change management experience.  Big-picture thinking, with strong reasoning and analytical skills to resolve issues.  Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

title: Driftsleder inden for Facility Management med fokus på rengøring og deskfunktion til Danmarks smukkeste arbejdsplads
location: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
description: Vil du stå i spidsen for en vigtig driftsfunktion på en af Danmarks mest unikke arbejdspladser? Vi søger en engageret driftsleder, der kan udvikle medarbejdere, sikre høj kvalitet og skabe en velfungerende hverdag inden for rengøring, deskfunktion og postservice på Kastellet.   Om Os   Etablissement –og Terrænkommandoen har hovedkontor i Hjørring, men har medarbejdere i hele landet.  Vi leverer og udvikler de fysiske rammer for de militære operative enheder og de øvrige myndigheder under Forsvarsministeriet. Vi sikrer varme og vand, udfører bygningsvedligeholdelse, mindre reparationer, driftsopgaver og meget, meget mere.  Mange af opgaverne løses fra 28 af de største arbejdssteder i hele landet.  Vi håndterer alt fra brugerhenvendelser og indkøb til arrangementsstøtte og bygningsvedligehold.  Etablissementspartnerelementet i Kastellet er tjenestestedets og brugernes primære indgangsvinkel til rekvirering af ydelser hos Etablissement –og Terrænkommandoen  Etablissementspartnerelementet består af i alt 35 medarbejdere med baggrund inden for administration, bygningsvedligehold, rengøring eller tekniske installationer. Alle arbejder tæt sammen, så der sikres en lokal støtte til brugerne, Vores bygningsmasse indeholder kontorfaciliteter, hotelindkvartering, beboelse og møde/undervisningsfaciliteter.  I vores partnerelement varetager vi drift af Kastellet og Nyboder, samt lejede faciliteter i København   Om Jobbet   Dine primære ansvarsområder  Som driftsleder får du ansvaret for den daglige ledelse af vores medarbejdere inden for rengøring, deskfunktion og postservice. Du skaber retning, motiverer medarbejderne og sikrer, at vores serviceleverancer lever op til høje kvalitetsstandarder.   Du Vil Blandt Andet Få Ansvar For At   Udøve nærværende og motiverende personaleledelse med fokus på trivsel, udvikling og engagement.  Planlægge og afholde personalemøder, teammøder og løbende 1:1-samtaler med medarbejderne.  Sikre den daglige bemanding og effektiv planlægning af driften.  Følge op på kvaliteten af serviceleverancerne og sikre, at vores brugere oplever en professionel, imødekommende og ensartet service.  Arbejde systematisk med kvalitetskontrol, løbende forbedringer og optimering af arbejdsgange.  Sikre, at deadlines, aftaler og serviceniveauer overholdes, og tage ansvar for at følge op på opgaverne.  Samarbejde tæt med interne kunder, brugere og øvrige samarbejdspartnere for at sikre en velfungerende hverdag.  Håndtere daglige driftsmæssige udfordringer og træffe beslutninger, der sikrer en stabil og effektiv drift.  Vi søger en leder, der går forrest, kommunikerer tydeligt, skaber tillid og formår at kombinere fokus på mennesker med et skarpt blik for kvalitet, struktur og resultater.  Der vil forekomme aktivitet rundt i landet til alle etablissementerne og herved vil en del af arbejdet ligge uden for normal arbejdstid.   Om Dig   Faglige kvalifikationer   Vi forventer, at du har en stærk faglig profil og erfaring med etablissementsdri

title: IT Service Delivery Manager (m/w/d) IT-Infrastrukturprojekte
description: Gestalte die digitale Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens   Möchtest du komplexe IT-Infrastrukturprojekte verantworten und gleichzeitig in einer Branche arbeiten, die einen echten gesellschaftlichen Beitrag leistet? Unser Kunde zählt zu den führenden Unternehmen im Healthcare-Bereich und bietet die Möglichkeit, an zukunftsweisenden IT-Lösungen zu arbeiten, die einen direkten Beitrag zur Gesundheitsversorgung leisten.     Für den Standort Wien (oder remote innerhalb Österreich) suchen wir einen  IT Service Delivery Manager (m/w/d) mit Schwerpunkt IT-Infrastrukturprojekte & Managed Services , der Kundenprojekte von der Implementierung bis zum laufenden Betrieb begleitet und dabei technische Expertise mit professionellem Stakeholder- und Kundenmanagement verbindet.   Deine Rolle    Du steuerst und koordinierst IT-Infrastrukturprojekte von der Planung über die Implementierung bis zur erfolgreichen Übergabe in den Betrieb.  Du verantwortest Projekte rund um Data Center, Server-, Storage- und Managed-Service-Lösungen und stellst deren erfolgreiche Umsetzung sicher.  Als zentrale Ansprechperson begleitest du Kund:innen über den gesamten Projekt- und Service-Lifecycle und führst regelmäßige Service- und Statusgespräche durch.  Du koordinierst interne Fachbereiche, technische Teams und externe Partner und sorgst für eine professionelle Zusammenarbeit aller Stakeholder.  Gemeinsam mit Vertrieb, Produktmanagement und Konzern-IT entwickelst und realisierst du kundenorientierte Lösungen.  Du verantwortest Scope, Zeitpläne, Budget, Ressourcen und Risiken und unterstützt technische sowie kommerzielle Abstimmungen.    Das bringst du mit    Min. 3 Jahre Erfahrung im IT Service Delivery Management, IT-Projektmanagement oder einer vergleichbaren Rolle im IT-Infrastrukturumfeld.  Erfahrung bei einem IT-Dienstleister, Managed-Service-Provider, Systemhaus oder einer vergleichbaren kundenorientierten IT-Organisation.  Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Umsetzung von IT-Infrastrukturprojekten, beispielsweise in den Bereichen Data Center, Server, Storage, Netzwerk oder Managed Services.  Erfahrung im direkten Kundenkontakt sowie in der Steuerung von Kundenprojekten.  Gute technische Kenntnisse von Rechenzentrums- und Infrastrukturumgebungen sowie die Fähigkeit, technische und fachliche Stakeholder erfolgreich zusammenzubringen.  Strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie Erfahrung im Management von Budgets, Ressourcen, Zeitplänen und Risiken.  Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.    Deine Vorteile     Spannende, verantwortungsvolle Aufgaben in einem international führenden Unternehmen  * Flexible Arbeitszeiten &  unbegrenztes Homeoffice   * Ein modernes, zentral gelegenes Büro in Wien mit perfekter Anbindung  * Attraktive Benefits eines international erfolgreichen Konzerns  * Gelegentliche Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Österreichs (bei wichtigen Projektphasen)  * Ein attraktives Gehalt von  bis zu ca. € 84.000 brutto p.a. title: Senior Product Operations Manager
description: Our Product, Engineering and Design teams are evolving how they work as we grow, bring our products closer together and make greater use of AI and automation.     As part of that, we’re moving closer to the “product operating model”, giving teams better customer and product insights, enabling decisions closer to the work and creating stronger connections between strategy, discovery and delivery, etc.  That’s why we’re hiring our first Product Operations Manager. You’ll build the function and shape how it develops over time.     You’ll work closely with Henrik, our VP of Product, and partner with leaders and teams across Product, Engineering, Design and the wider business. You won’t inherit a finished Product Operations setup. You’ll identify where dedicated support can create the greatest leverage, build on what already works, and establish an approach that fits Zensai. This is an enablement role: you’ll improve the information, systems and operating rhythm around product work without taking craft or product decisions away from the teams that own them.      What You’ll Be Doing    Create clarity and alignment across Product, Engineering and Design.  Bring customer feedback, product usage and business data together so teams can identify the right problems, test ideas earlier and make informed product decisions. description: Viimeinen hakupäivä: 20. syyskuuta 2026    Hybridi     Työn kuvaus   Yhdistä ihmisten, asiakkuuksien ja liiketoiminnan johtaminen.   Me Aspialla olemme talous- ja palkkahallinnon edelläkävijöitä. Uteliaisuus, kasvu ja jatkuva kehittyminen ohjaavat tekemistämme – haluamme olla askeleen edellä niin osaamisessa kuin asiakaskokemuksessa. Avoin ja joustava työympäristömme tarjoaa sinulle mahdollisuuden kasvaa asiantuntijana.   Sytytkö ihmisten johtamisesta, asiakkuuksien kehittämisestä ja kasvun rakentamisesta?    Me Aspialla olemme asiantuntijayhteisö, joka seisoo rohkeiden kasvajien rinnalla. Teemme palkkahallinnosta selkeää, jotta asiakkaamme voivat keskittyä kasvuun. Meille kasvu tarkoittaa ennen kaikkea ihmisten, osaamisen ja vastuun kehittymistä.  Haemme kahta dynaamista palvelupäällikköä liittymään palkkaliiketoiminnan asiantuntijatiimeihimme Espoon ja Vaasan toimistoille/ Pohjanmaan seudulle vahvistamaan asiantuntijavetoista ja asiakaslähtöistä toimintamalliamme. Roolissa yhdistyvät palkkahallinnon ymmärrys, asiakkuusvastuu, myynnillinen ajattelu ja oman asiantuntijatiimin johtaminen. Vaasan/ Pohjanmaan seudun työsuhde on määräaikainen, perhevapaan sijainen vuoden 2027 loppuun.  Huolehdit asiakaskokonaisuuksien sujuvasta toteutuksesta, palvelun laadusta sekä tiimisi toimituskyvystä ja kannattavuudesta. Johdat kokonaisuuttasi tavoitteellisesti, mutta et yksin: tukenasi ovat kollegat ja laaja asiantuntijaverkosto. Arjessasi yhdistyvät operatiivinen johtaminen ja pidemmän aikavälin kehittäminen. Olet lähellä tiimiä ja asiakkaita, tunnistat kehitys- ja kasvumahdollisuuksia sekä viet asioita käytäntöön yhdessä muiden kanssa.   Myynti ja kasvu    Roolissa on myynnillinen vastuu osana asiakkuuksien kehittämistä ja liiketoiminnan kasvua. Myynti muodostuu sekä nykyisten asiakkuuksien pitkäjänteisestä kehittämisestä että uusien mahdollisuuksien edistämisestä. Osallistut aktiivisesti asiakastilanteisiin ja liiketoiminnan kasvattamiseen. Olet mukana ratkaisujen rakentamisessa ja tarjousten valmistelussa yhdessä myyjien ja asiantuntijoiden kanssa.   Tiimin johtaminen    Johdat palkka-asiantuntijoita valmentavasti ja tuet heidän ammatillista kasvuaan, priorisoit tekemistä ja rakennat arkea, jossa tavoitteet ovat ymmärrettäviä ja onnistuminen mahdollista. Osaat tehdä päätöksiä, tarttua haastaviinkin tilanteisiin ja samalla vahvistaa luottamusta sekä yhdessä tekemistä.   Aspian arvot, yhteistyö, uteliaisuus ja välittävä neuvonantajuus, näkyvät tavassasi toimia niin tiimin kuin asiakkaiden kanssa. description: Overview   This role is responsible for building and institutionalizing  World-Class Customer Engagement (WCCE)  across all B&M key accounts within SodaStream, driving a step-change in how the organization engages with retailers globally. With this achieved, we secured funding to support our expansion and have embarked on an ambitious scaling of our product engineering team that will rapidly evolve our platform using the latest cloud-native and full-stack technologies to achieve a leadership position in our selected markets. We seek ambitious product engineers (not just software developers) with experience in cloud-native approaches that can shape our platform strategy and accelerate our product development plans.  This role provides an excellent opportunity to both learn and contribute to all aspects of a fast-growing fintech company, within the payments sector and supporting major corporate clients within, amongst others, the Insurance and Financial Services sector.   The Role:   Reporting into the VP of Customer Success, you will have the opportunity to lead our Carrier Customer Success team in delivering a material revenue growth target. You’ll do this by helping Carriers migrate more of their existing business onto Vitesse, demonstrating measurable ROI, and identifying qualified expansion opportunities in partnership with Sales.  As Vitesse typically starts with a focused footprint, you'll ensure your team understands each carrier's current position and growth potential. They'll build strong relationships from operational users through to senior executives, and mobilise the right people within Vitesse to realise it - all underpinned by deep adoption and strong customer health.  You'll lead a team of CSMs while personally owning 1-3 strategic carrier accounts.
